We address both jointly with Test-Time Self-Distillation (TTSD), a parameter-efficient framework in which a frozen teacher, trained on complete modalities, guides an adaptive low-rank student via self-distillation, updating only a negligible number of parameters. Stability is built into this same loop through Fisher-Anchored Restoration (FAR), which monitors Fisher information stability to detect convergence versus drift and restores the student toward the teacher's anchor when distributional shifts are identified. Our experiments on MELD, DFEW, and BAH under 0%-50% missing modalities show that this unified adaptation-restoration design consistently outperforms entropy-based adaptation, RAG, and perplexity-based generation over long adaptation horizons, where baselines without restoration progressively degrade while TTSD-FAR remains consistent.
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在真实场景多模态情感识别等多模态任务上表现优异。情感识别本质上是多模态任务，需要对人脸表情、语音、语言、生理信号与手势进行联合理解。但真实场景部署仍面临诸多挑战：测试阶段可能出现模态缺失或噪声问题，部分观测场景可视为相对于全模态分布的分布偏移。现有基于熵最小化或困惑度降低的最优测试时自适应方法无法直接迁移到自回归大视觉语言模型，而检索增强生成（RAG）方法在观测模态质量较差时性能会明显下降。由于不存在真值监督来验证每一步更新，持续自适应过程中模型容易累积漂移，偏离可靠解后性能下降。因此有效的解决方案需要适配任意缺失模态模式，且在持续自适应过程中保持性能稳定。本文提出测试时自蒸馏（TTSD）参数高效框架解决上述问题：在全模态数据上训练得到的冻结教师模型通过自蒸馏引导可自适应的低秩学生模型，仅更新极少量参数。框架通过费希尔锚定恢复（FAR）机制保障稳定性：监控费希尔信息的稳定性以判断模型是收敛还是发生漂移，当检测到分布偏移时将学生模型向教师模型的锚点方向恢复。本文在MELD、DFEW与BAH数据集上设置0%-50%的模态缺失比例开展实验，结果表明该自适应-恢复一体化设计在长时自适应场景下性能持续优于基于熵的自适应方法、检索增强生成方法与基于困惑度的生成方法：不带恢复机制的基线方法性能会逐步下降，而TTSD-FAR的性能始终保持稳定。

title: Optic Disc Segmentation in Fundus Images: From Classical Image Processing and Deformable Models to Modern AI
title_zh: 眼底图像视盘分割：从经典图像处理与可变形模型到现代人工智能
authors: Buket D. Barkana
abstract: Accurate localization and segmentation of the optic disc (OD) are important for retinal image analysis and glaucoma assessment, yet remain challenging due to variations in illumination, pathology, vascular interference, and poorly defined boundaries. This structured methodological review examines the evolution of OD segmentation from classical image-processing and deformable models to contemporary artificial intelligence (AI)-based approaches. A structured literature search and study-selection process was used to identify representative studies spanning major methodological developments. The review first summarizes commonly used fundus-image datasets, then organizes classical methods by principal mechanisms, including intensity and thresholding, histogram and entropy analysis, morphology, geometric and Hough-transform methods, filtering and feature operators, texture- and region-based approaches, and active-contour and level-set models. This paper pays particular attention to the assumptions, strengths, limitations, and complementary roles of these methods in OD localization and boundary delineation. Representative AI approaches are subsequently examined to illustrate the transition from handcrafted features and explicitly defined priors to learned representations, Transformer-based segmentation, boundary- and shape-aware learning, promptable segmentation, and retinal foundation models. Across these methodological generations, several core segmentation principles persist, including region-of-interest localization, multiscale representation, geometric and anatomical constraints, and boundary regularization, although their implementation has shifted from predefined operators to learned modules, losses, prompts, and pretrained representations. The review further identifies boundary ambiguity, anatomical variability, domain shift, and cross-dataset generalization as continuing challenges.
summary_zh: 视盘（OD）的准确定位与分割对视网膜图像分析与青光眼评估至关重要，但受光照变化、病理干扰、血管遮挡、边界模糊等因素影响，该任务仍存在诸多挑战。本文是结构化方法综述，梳理了视盘分割技术从经典图像处理、可变形模型到当代人工智能方法的演进路径。本文通过结构化文献检索与研究筛选流程，覆盖了各阶段代表性方法。综述首先总结了常用的眼底图像数据集，随后按核心机制对经典方法进行分类梳理，包括强度与阈值法、直方图与熵分析法、形态学方法、几何与霍夫变换法、滤波与特征算子法、纹理与区域法、主动轮廓与水平集模型，重点分析了各类方法的假设前提、优势、局限性，以及其在视盘定位与边界勾勒中的互补作用。随后综述梳理了代表性人工智能方法，展示了从手工特征、显式先验到学习表征、Transformer分割、边界与形状感知学习、提示式分割、视网膜基础模型的技术演进路径。跨代际的方法中，多项核心分割原则始终保持一致，包括感兴趣区域定位、多尺度表征、几何与解剖约束、边界正则化，只是其实现方式从预定义算子转变为可学习模块、损失函数、提示与预训练表征。最后本文指出边界歧义、解剖个体差异、域偏移、跨数据集泛化仍是该领域待解决的核心挑战。

title: From Inference to Adaptation: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Vision Language Model
title_zh: 从推理到自适应：视觉语言模型的统一最优传输视角
authors: Qi Yu, Zhichen Zeng, Katherine Tieu, Xiyuan Yang, Ruizhong Qiu, Yuchen Yan, Lihui Liu, Yanjun Zhao, Lingjie Chen, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities yet remain sensitive to real-world distribution shifts during inference. Although significant efforts are devoted to adapting VLMs at test time, they rely heavily on noisy pseudo-labels predicted directly from raw embedding similarities during inference, which are unreliable under distribution shift and mislead the adaptation. To avoid noise amplification, existing works craft coarse-grained surrogate objectives during adaptation, which fail to explicitly model sample-level relationships across different modalities, creating objective mismatch with inference, thus leading to marginal performance improvement. In this work, we aim to bridge the detached objectives of inference and adaptation for VLMs, and propose a principled VLM TTA method called \algname. For VLM inference, we formulate the zero-shot image classification task as a cross-modal alignment problem encoded via a Wasserstein OT formulation, providing robust pseudo-labels at the sample-level to effectively adapt VLMs. For VLM adaptation, we adopt a soft-label InfoNCE loss to adapt VLMs based on the OT-induced pseudo-labels, leveraging fine-grained supervisions to explicitly model relationships of individual image-text pairs via contrastive learning, which empowers accurate inference at the same granularity. Moreover, we theoretically reveal that the InfoNCE loss can be neatly reformulated as a Wasserstein OT formulation, thereby unifying the objectives of the inference and adaptation of VLMs to achieve their mutual benefits. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our methods, outperforming the best-performing methods by up to 7% with state-of-the-art efficiency.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）展现了优异的零样本能力，但推理阶段对真实场景的分布偏移仍十分敏感。当前大量研究聚焦于视觉语言模型的测试时自适应，但这类方法高度依赖推理阶段直接从原始嵌入相似度预测得到的噪声伪标签，在分布偏移场景下伪标签可靠性差，反而会误导自适应过程。为避免噪声放大，现有自适应方法设计了粗粒度的替代目标，无法显式建模跨模态的样本级关联，导致自适应目标与推理目标不匹配，性能提升十分有限。本文旨在打通视觉语言模型推理与自适应阶段相互独立的目标，提出基于最优传输的原则性视觉语言模型测试时自适应方法。在推理阶段，本文将零样本图像分类任务建模为通过瓦瑟斯坦最优传输（Wasserstein OT）公式编码的跨模态对齐问题，生成样本级的鲁棒伪标签用于后续自适应。在自适应阶段，本文基于最优传输生成的伪标签采用软标签InfoNCE损失（信息噪声对比估计损失）对视觉语言模型进行适配，通过细粒度监督信号以对比学习的方式显式建模单个图文对的关联，支撑同等粒度下的精确推理。本文还从理论层面证明，InfoNCE损失可被简洁地重构为瓦瑟斯坦最优传输形式，从而统一视觉语言模型的推理与自适应目标，实现两者的协同增益。大量实验验证了本文方法的有效性与高效性，性能比当前最优方法最高高出7%，同时保持领先的推理效率。

title: Reproducible Multimodal Affordance Prediction
title_zh: 可复现的多模态可供性预测
authors: Tommaso Apicella, Alessio Xompero, Andrea Cavallaro
abstract: Affordance prediction is the identification of potential actions an agent can perform on a target object from multimodal inputs. Affordance prediction methods are difficult to evaluate and compare due to heterogeneous problem formulations, inconsistent dataset annotations, incomplete reporting of experimental protocols, and limited information about deployment conditions. These limitations challenge fair benchmarking and performance comparison. To promote transparency, we propose the Affordance Sheet, a documentation detailing task formulation with its input modalities, model architectures and training information, datasets, and experimental protocols. Affordance Sheets enable reproducible benchmarking and reliable evaluation of affordance models for real-world scenarios, including generalisation to novel conditions and human safety.
summary_zh: 可供性预测任务的目标是从多模态输入中识别出智能体可对目标物体执行的潜在动作。由于问题定义异构、数据集标注不一致、实验协议报告不完整、部署条件相关信息缺失，可供性预测方法的评估与对比难度较高，阻碍了公平基准测试与性能比较。为提升研究透明度，本文提出可供性文档（Affordance Sheet）机制，用于完整记录任务定义、输入模态、模型架构与训练信息、数据集、实验协议等全部内容。可供性文档可支撑可供性模型的可复现基准测试与可靠评估，覆盖真实场景下的各类需求，包括新场景泛化能力与人类安全相关特性评估。

title: A Configurable Privacy-Preserving MRI Processing Workflow Using Deep Learning-Based Brain Extraction and Adaptive Anatomical Preservation
title_zh: 基于深度学习脑提取与自适应解剖保留的可配置隐私保护磁共振成像处理工作流
authors: Rayeef Ali Khan, Komal Raj Mahantesh
abstract: Structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely used in neuroimaging research and clinical practice, but structural MRI volumes may retain facial and cranial anatomical information that raises privacy concerns. Existing deep learning-based brain extraction methods generally produce a single fixed output, limiting flexibility when different applications require different balances between privacy and anatomical preservation. This paper presents a configurable privacy-preserving MRI processing workflow that extends deep learning-based brain extraction through adaptive anatomical preservation, interactive preservation selection, and integrated quality control. The workflow employs SynthStrip for automated brain extraction, followed by morphological mask expansion to generate configurable shell-based preservation levels. An Interactive Preservation Framework enables users to compare preservation configurations and select an appropriate output, while an integrated Quality Control Framework provides multi-plane visualisation and brain-mask overlay verification. The workflow was implemented in Python using open-source neuroimaging libraries within the Renku reproducible research environment and evaluated using structural T1-weighted MRI data from the publicly available IXI dataset. Experimental results demonstrate anatomically plausible brain extraction and configurable preservation outputs, supported by systematic visual verification. The principal contribution is a modular and reproducible MRI preprocessing framework that enhances deep learning-based brain extraction with configurable anatomical preservation, interactive user-guided processing, and integrated quality control. The workflow provides a practical foundation for privacy-oriented neuroimaging research and collaborative medical image analysis.
summary_zh: 结构磁共振成像（MRI）已广泛应用于神经影像研究与临床实践，但结构MRI体数据可能留存面部与颅部解剖信息，引发隐私风险。现有基于深度学习的脑提取方法通常仅生成单一固定输出，难以适配不同应用场景下隐私保护与解剖保留的差异化平衡需求。本文提出一种可配置隐私保护MRI处理工作流，通过自适应解剖保留、交互式保留选择与集成化质量控制模块对深度学习脑提取流程进行扩展。该工作流首先采用SynthStrip（自动脑提取工具）完成自动化脑提取，随后通过形态学掩码扩张生成可配置的基于外壳层级的保留等级。交互式保留框架支持用户对比不同保留配置并选择合适输出，集成化质量控制框架则提供多平面可视化与脑掩码叠加验证功能。该工作流基于开源神经影像库在Renku可复现研究环境中使用Python实现，采用公开IXI数据集的结构T1加权MRI数据完成评估。实验结果经系统化视觉验证表明，该方法可生成解剖学合理的脑提取结果与可配置保留输出。本研究的核心贡献是构建了模块化、可复现的MRI预处理框架，在深度学习脑提取的基础上新增了可配置解剖保留、用户引导交互式处理与集成质量控制能力，为面向隐私保护的神经影像研究与协作式医学图像分析提供了实用基础。

title: FedCoRe: Target-Adaptive Completion for Missing Modalities in Healthcare Federated Learning
title_zh: FedCoRe：面向医疗联邦学习中缺失模态的目标自适应补全方法
authors: Holger R. Roth, Ziyue Xu, Peter Cnudde
abstract: Federated multimodal models often assume every site has every modality, although hospitals differ in access to EHRs, chest radiographs, and ECGs. We study this setting on a MIMIC-derived respiratory deterioration task with simulated FL clients and introduce FedCoRe (Federated Cross-Modal Representation Completion). FedCoRe learns representation- or logit-space corrections rather than generating synthetic ECGs or CXR images. When a client observes a modality that may be missing at deployment, it evaluates the same example with and without that modality to obtain paired supervision. Only clients with such pairs update the completion module, and validation may retain the unchanged prediction. We freeze the trained multimodal predictor during evaluation so that measured differences come only from completion. Hiding ECG reduced AUROC by about 0.085; paired-example FedAvg restored 0.0415 AUROC, or 49.0% of the lost performance. We therefore report two distinct effects: paired-example FedAvg partially recovers the missing-ECG gap, while validation-selected completion is a task-specific classifier-logit correction rather than literal ECG recovery. For CXR, effect-aware completion recovers 52.8% of the loss in a controlled test where CXR is hidden. Paired-example FedAvg transfers part of this effect, but validation keeps the no-completion baseline for deployment cases whose inputs lack CXR. Thus, FedCoRe should be read as a validation-gated completion/correction framework: it can recover missing-modality signal in supported settings, but it should be deployed only when paired examples and validation evidence support that modality.
summary_zh: 联邦多模态模型通常假设所有参与站点都具备全部模态数据，但不同医院的电子健康记录（EHR）、胸片、心电图（ECG）资源配置情况存在显著差异。本文针对该场景，基于MIMIC数据集构建呼吸恶化预测任务并模拟联邦学习客户端，提出FedCoRe（Federated Cross-Modal Representation Completion，联邦跨模态表征补全）方法。FedCoRe在表征空间或对数几率空间执行校正，无需生成合成ECG或胸片图像。当客户端采集到部署阶段可能缺失的模态时，会对同一样本分别在包含该模态和不包含该模态的条件下进行推理，获得成对监督信号。仅拥有这类成对样本的客户端会更新补全模块，验证过程可保留原始未修改的预测结果。评估阶段冻结训练好的多模态预测器，确保观测到的性能差异完全来自补全模块。实验结果显示，隐藏ECG数据会使AUROC下降约0.085；基于成对样本的FedAvg方法可恢复0.0415的AUROC，占损失性能的49.0%。据此本文总结了两种不同效应：成对样本FedAvg可部分缓解ECG缺失带来的性能损失，而经验证筛选的补全操作是面向任务的分类器对数几率校正，并非对ECG信号的完全还原。针对胸片模态的对照测试中，效应感知补全可恢复52.8%的性能损失。成对样本FedAvg可迁移部分该效应，但对于输入不含胸片的部署场景，验证过程会选择无补全的基线方案。因此FedCoRe可被视为一种由验证机制门控的补全/校正框架：其可在满足条件的场景下恢复缺失模态的信号，但仅当存在成对样本且验证结果支持该模态补全时才可部署。

title: XRF-to-Optical Field-of-View Localization with Vision Language Models
title_zh: 基于视觉语言模型的X射线荧光视场到光学图像的定位方法
authors: Xiangyu Yin, Tatjana Paunesku, Letonia Copeland-Hardin, Martina Ralle, Zichao Wendy Di, Si Chen, Gayle E. Woloschak, Barry Lai, Mathew J. Cherukara, Stefan Vogt
abstract: Registering images acquired with different microscopy modalities is essential for relating complementary measurements of the same specimen. In correlative X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and optical microscopy, the XRF map often covers only a small region of an optical image acquired from the same or an adjacent tissue section. Field-of-view (FOV) localization is necessary but can be difficult when appearance and structure differ across modalities. Here we evaluate training-free vision language model (VLM) localization on two datasets representing same-section high-correspondence and adjacent-section low-correspondence imaging. We test unconstrained and metadata-constrained search and compare VLMs with geometric controls, classical template matching, and two alternative training-free approaches (DINOv2 and multiGradICON). Direct VLM prompting produced content-dependent spatial signals but was not reliable alone. Classical matching was most accurate when cross-modal structure was preserved but failed in the low-correspondence collection. A proposal-and-verify workflow used repeated VLM predictions as candidates and image-based similarity to select the final location. This workflow recovered useful localization in the low-correspondence regime.
summary_zh: 对不同显微模态采集的图像进行配准，是关联同一标本多组互补测量结果的核心步骤。在关联X射线荧光（XRF）与光学显微的研究场景中，XRF映射图通常仅覆盖同一组织切片或相邻切片光学图像的一小部分区域。跨模态外观与结构差异较大时，视场（FOV）定位任务难度显著提升。本文在两个数据集上评估无需训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）定位性能，两个数据集分别对应同一切片高匹配度成像与相邻切片低匹配度成像场景。本文测试了无约束搜索与元数据约束搜索两种模式，将VLM方法与几何对照方法、传统模板匹配方法以及两种其他免训练方法（DINOv2与multiGradICON）进行对比。直接对VLM进行提示可生成与内容相关的空间信号，但单独使用可靠性不足。当跨模态结构保留完整时传统模板匹配精度最高，但在低匹配度数据集上完全失效。本文提出的提议-验证工作流将VLM多次预测结果作为候选位置，基于图像相似度筛选最终定位结果，该工作流在低匹配度场景下仍可实现有效定位。

title: High-Flux Count-Free Single-Photon 3D Cameras
title_zh: 高通量无计数单光子3D相机
authors: Kaustubh Sadekar, Vivek K Goyal, David Maier, Atul Ingle
abstract: Single-photon cameras based on single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) technology are gaining popularity for 3D sensing, thanks to their extreme sensitivity and time resolution. There are two key challenges with single-photon cameras that limit their widespread use: (i) they suffer from non-linear distortions called ''pile-up'' when operated in high-photon-flux conditions, and (ii) they generate a large volume of raw photon data, creating a severe data bottleneck at each sensor pixel. In this work, we show that while compressive capture techniques successfully mitigate data transfer challenges, they exacerbate the effects of dead-time distortion because they fail to retain sufficient information about the photon detection history to allow post-processing pile-up correction via existing methods. We propose a new computational-imaging method that combines free-running capture with an analysis-by-synthesis software pipeline to mitigate pile-up distortions. Our results with hardware emulations and full-scene and single-pixel simulations show that our method can reliably capture scene distance and reflectance over a wide range of illumination conditions. Our work will enable high-resolution SPAD cameras that are severely bandwidth-constrained to operate in real-world high-flux scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）技术的单光子相机凭借极高的灵敏度与时间分辨率，在3D传感领域得到广泛应用。当前单光子相机的大规模落地仍受两个核心问题制约：（1）在高光通量场景下会出现名为“光子堆积”的非线性畸变；（2）会生成海量原始光子数据，在每个传感器像素处形成严重的数据瓶颈。本研究发现，尽管 compressive 采集技术可有效缓解数据传输难题，但由于其无法保留足够的光子检测历史信息以支持现有方法对光子堆积畸变进行后处理校正，反而会加剧死区时间畸变的影响。本文提出一种新型计算成像方法，将自由运行采集与基于合成分析的软件流水线相结合，可有效缓解光子堆积畸变。基于硬件仿真、全场景与单像素仿真的实验结果表明，该方法可在宽光照条件范围内可靠采集场景深度与反射率信息，可支持带宽受限的高分辨率SPAD相机在真实高通量场景下正常运行。

title: Acquisition Geometry-Assisted Whole-Group Localization of X-ray Fluorescence Maps in Optical Microscopy Images
title_zh: 采集几何辅助的X射线荧光映射图在光学显微图像中的整组定位方法
authors: Xiangyu Yin, Tatjana Paunesku, Letonia Copeland-Hardin, Martina Ralle, Zichao Wendy Di, Si Chen, Gayle E. Woloschak, Barry Lai, Mathew J. Cherukara, Stefan Vogt
abstract: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) microscopy maps elemental distributions, while optical microscopy can provide complementary morphological context. Localizing XRF fields of view (FOVs) in optical images is difficult because the two modalities differ in contrast mechanism and resolution. Most current workflows place each XRF tile independently, even when acquisition metadata already record the tiles' relative scan positions. This study formalizes XRF tile-group localization, in which one optical-frame placement is estimated for the whole group, constrained by acquisition geometry and quantified using group intersection-over-union (GroupIoU). In a controlled case study, independent localization failed with GroupIoU 0.000, whereas group localization achieved 0.931. Replacing the normalized cross-correlation (NCC) metric with mutual information (MI) gave nearly identical results, showing that the outcome is not specific to one local similarity metric. In another multiscale case study, using a coarse XRF survey scan to connect the fine-scale tile group to the optical image increased mean GroupIoU from 0.694 to 0.856. These case studies support using acquisition geometry as an explicit constraint when localizing related XRF tiles.
summary_zh: X射线荧光（XRF）显微技术可映射元素分布，而光学显微可提供互补的形态学上下文信息。由于两种模态的成像对比度机制与分辨率存在差异，将XRF视场（FOV）定位到光学图像的难度较高。现有多数工作流会对每个XRF图像块进行独立定位，即便采集元数据已经记录了所有图像块的相对扫描位置。本研究正式定义了XRF图像块组定位任务：基于采集几何约束，为整组图像块估计一个统一的光学帧放置结果，采用组交并比（GroupIoU）对定位精度进行量化。在对照案例研究中，独立定位方法的GroupIoU仅为0.000完全失效，而整组定位方法的GroupIoU可达0.931。将归一化互相关（NCC）度量替换为互信息（MI）后结果几乎一致，表明该结论不依赖特定的局部相似度度量指标。在另一项多尺度案例研究中，使用粗粒度XRF扫描将细粒度图像块组关联到光学图像，可将平均GroupIoU从0.694提升至0.856。上述案例研究结果证明，对关联的XRF图像块进行定位时，将采集几何作为显式约束可显著提升定位性能。

title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
title_zh: GuideFetch：面向辅助机器犬并发导航与物体抓取的任务协同框架
authors: Qian Yin, Ruiping Liu, Kunyu Peng, Jianxiang Man, Isik Baran Sandan, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Kailun Yang, Rainer Stiefelhagen
abstract: Consider a robot guide dog escorting a blind user to an available seat while a second assistive robot dog concurrently retrieves a cup of coffee and delivers it to the same seat. This setting motivates concurrent execution because navigation and object retrieval can overlap. A syntactically valid Large Language Model (LLM) plan may still violate embodiment constraints, and successful-looking controller motion does not by itself establish task completion. We introduce \textsc{GuideFetch}, a coordination framework for concurrent navigation and object retrieval by a heterogeneous guider and fetcher team. An LLM instantiates a schedule-conditioned four-action schema from a natural-language instruction. Before execution, robot, skill, and target aliases are normalized, and proposed actions are validated against registered targets, robot capabilities, and the selected schedule. Robot and object states then govern sequential and parallel execution. In a matched $2\times2$ study across 90 combinations of scene and seed (360 executions), all 180 online LLM responses validate without fallback or replay and match the corresponding scripted plans. For each planner source, sequential and parallel execution achieve $72/90$ and $71/90$ operational successes, respectively. Among the 56 cases completed by both schedules, parallel execution reduces mean makespan by 41.3\%. Within this controlled setting, role specialization and action overlap shorten completed missions, while state checks distinguish plan validity from verified mission completion. Source code will be available.
summary_zh: 设想如下场景：一台导盲机器犬护送视障用户前往空位，同时另一台辅助机器犬同步取回一杯咖啡并送到同一座位。该场景下导航与物体抓取任务可并行执行，因此采用并发模式可显著提升效率。大语言模型（LLM）生成的语法合法规划仍可能违反具身约束，且控制器生成的看似成功的运动也不能直接证明任务完成。本文提出GuideFetch协同框架，支持由导航机器犬与抓取机器犬组成的异构团队并发完成导航与物体抓取任务。LLM可基于自然语言指令实例化符合调度条件的四动作模式。执行前系统会对机器人、技能与目标别名进行归一化处理，对照注册目标、机器人能力与选定调度方案对拟执行动作进行校验，随后由机器人与物体状态管控顺序与并行执行流程。在覆盖90种场景与随机种子组合的2×2对照实验中（共360次执行），所有180次在线LLM生成的响应全部通过校验，无需回退或重放，且与对应脚本规划完全匹配。针对不同规划源，顺序执行与并行执行的任务成功率分别为72/90与71/90。在两种调度方案均完成的56个案例中，并行执行将平均任务完成时间缩短了41.3%。在该受控场景下，角色专业化与动作重叠可缩短任务总时长，状态校验机制可区分规划合法性与已验证的任务完成性。相关源代码将对外公开。

title: QuARC-GS: Quantized Anchored Residual Coding for Compact Dynamic Scene Streaming with Gaussian Splatting
authors: Vu Trung Nghia Nguyen, Yuchen Wang, Kyung Chul Lee, Kevin C. Zhou
abstract: 3D scene representation techniques such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and Gaussian splatting have made substantial progress in novel view synthesis, achieving high-quality renderings from arbitrary view angles. More recently, such techniques have been extended to dynamic 3D scenes; however, achieving sustainable online free-viewpoint video (FVV) streaming remains challenging, especially for longer videos, due to significant storage demands of detailed scene representations and high reconstruction/rendering speed needs. To address these challenges, we propose Quantized Anchored Residual Coding Gaussian Streaming (QuARC-GS), a quantization-aware 4D scene optimization framework for online dynamic scene reconstruction that achieves ultra-high compression while maintaining reconstruction speed and quality. QuARC-GS represents a scene using a single canonical frame and highly compressed per-frame residuals. Specifically, we compress each residual through two complementary strategies targeting motion, appearance, and densification. We introduce quantization-aware anchor deformation, which suppresses insignificant motion updates while preserving meaningful deformations, maintaining reconstruction quality under low-storage streaming. Furthermore, we design a change-gated densification strategy that allocates new Gaussians only in regions exhibiting genuine temporal changes, effectively eliminating redundant appearance updates and reducing storage overhead. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets demonstrate that QuARC-GS enables competitive reconstruction quality and training speed while cutting per-frame storage by up to 11$\times$ compared to the state-of-the-art.

title: Visual-Prompt Guided Wildlife Instance-Level Recognition
title_zh: 视觉提示引导的野生动物实例级识别方法
authors: Mufhumudzi Muthivhi, Jiahao Huo, Terence van Zyl, Fredrik Gustafsson
abstract: Fine-grained wildlife re-identification remains a challenging area in research. Current state-of-the-art approaches apply a detection and re-identification pipeline. We propose a one-stage end-to-end detection and re-identification model that performs identity searching within the latent space. We adopt DINOv2 for robust spatial geometry and MegaDescriptor for wildlife re-identification. We enhance latent queries with prompt re-identification features. A detection decoder queries the scene latent space to establish object boundaries around the target identity. Preliminary findings reflect a competitive mean average precision score of 30.584% compared to the state-of-the-art two stage approach of 44.89%. Qualitative results depict effective bounding and identification of animal identities.
summary_zh: 细粒度野生动物重识别是当前研究领域的难点问题。现有最优方法普遍采用检测加重识别的流水线架构。本文提出一种单阶段端到端检测与重识别模型，可在隐空间内完成身份检索。该模型采用DINOv2提取鲁棒的空间几何特征，采用MegaDescriptor完成野生动物重识别任务，通过提示重识别特征增强隐空间查询，检测解码器对场景隐空间进行查询，围绕目标身份生成物体边界框。初步实验结果显示，该方法的平均精度均值为30.584%，与最优两阶段方法的44.89%相比具备竞争力。定性结果表明该方法可有效生成动物边界框并完成个体身份识别。

title: Zero-Shot Transfer of Force Map Estimation Across GelSight Mini Sensors
title_zh: 跨GelSight Mini传感器的力图估计零样本迁移方法
authors: Julio Casta\~no Amoros, Pablo Gil
abstract: Despite the rapid industrialization of the touch sensor manufacturing process, most of these sensors are still handmade in research laboratories. This complicates standardizing their performance, requiring the repetition of data collection and training models for each unit produced. To address this problem, this paper presents a method that can generalize the estimation of 3D force maps across different GelSight Mini sensor units, regardless of the sensor version. Specifically, the method consists of two stages: a domain adaptation stage, in which the input tactile image is reconstructed as a general tactile image using a UniT-based model; and a stage for estimating 3D force maps employing a U-Net network. Our proposal achieves promising results in both steps, such as an SSIM of 0.9338 +- 0.0358 in the image reconstruction phase and an MAE_F of 1.1294 +- 1.5934(N) in the force estimation phase.
summary_zh: 尽管触觉传感器制造流程已快速工业化，多数研究场景下使用的传感器仍为实验室手工制作，难以实现性能标准化，导致每台新生产的传感器都需要重新采集数据并训练专属模型。针对该问题，本文提出一种可跨不同型号GelSight Mini触觉传感器泛化3D力图估计任务的方法。该方法分为两个阶段：第一阶段为域适应阶段，基于UniT模型将输入触觉图像重建为通用触觉图像；第二阶段采用U-Net网络完成3D力图估计。本文提出的方法在两个阶段均取得了优异结果：图像重建阶段的结构相似度（SSIM）达到0.9338±0.0358，力估计阶段的平均绝对误差MAE_F为1.1294±1.5934(N)。

title: LumiTokens: 3D Relighting via Token-Space Lighting Transformation
title_zh: LumiTokens：基于令牌空间光照变换的3D重光照方法
authors: Yiwen Chen, Matheus Gadelha, Huaizu Jiang
abstract: Existing 3D relighting methods operate through either explicit material decomposition, diffusion-based view-space generation, or a combination of both, requiring full recomputation for each new lighting condition. We observe that recent latent scene representations, which encode multi-view images into a set of compact tokens with no fixed physical semantics, open up a novel design space for relighting. We present LumiTokens, a framework that formulates 3D relighting as a direct transformation on latent scene tokens, without explicit 3D representations, rendering equations, or physics-based decomposition. Our model introduces a Scene Token Editor that processes scene tokens jointly with light-ray tokens through self-attention, producing updated tokens that can be decoded into multi-view-consistent relit images. To support diverse lighting types through a unified interface, all lighting signals, including environment maps, point lights, and area lights, are parameterized as Plucker ray tokens, enabling native 3D user interaction with a representation that carries no explicit spatial structure. Crucially, this design supports progressive relighting: because the editor's output remains in the same latent space as its input, a user can incrementally build up illumination one light source at a time, with each edit composing in token space. Experiments demonstrate that LumiTokens achieves comparable or superior relighting quality to other methods and supports progressive, composable lighting edits. Project page: https://neu-vi.github.io/LumiTokens/
summary_zh: 现有3D重光照方法要么采用显式材质分解、要么采用基于扩散模型的视图空间生成，或是将两种方案结合，每次更换光照条件都需要进行完全重新计算。本文发现，最新的隐式场景表征方法可将多视图图像编码为一组无固定物理语义的紧凑令牌，为重光照任务提供了全新的设计空间。本文提出LumiTokens框架，将3D重光照建模为对隐式场景令牌的直接变换，无需显式3D表征、渲染方程或基于物理的分解。该模型引入场景令牌编辑器，通过自注意力机制联合处理场景令牌与光线令牌，生成的更新后令牌可解码为符合多视图一致性的重光照图像。为通过统一接口支持多种光照类型，所有光照信号（包括环境贴图、点光源、面光源）均被参数化为普吕克光线令牌，支持用户对无显式空间结构的表征进行原生3D交互。该设计的核心优势是支持渐进式重光照：由于编辑器输出与输入处于同一隐空间，用户可逐个添加光源逐步构建光照效果，每次编辑都可在令牌空间完成合成。实验结果表明，LumiTokens的重光照质量与其他现有方法相当甚至更优，且支持渐进式、可组合的光照编辑操作。项目主页：https://neu-vi.github.io/LumiTokens/

title: Bound-Aware Per-Organ Recall Risk Control for Multi-Organ CT Segmentation under Clinical Domain Shift
title_zh: 临床域偏移下多器官CT分割的边界感知逐器官召回风险控制
authors: Souraj Adhikary, Negar Chabi, Andre Mastmeyer
abstract: Distribution-free risk control adds organ-specific recall guarantees to frozen segmentation. We calibrate per-organ thresholds for an AMOS-trained nnU-Net, audit transfer to RAOS, and estimate local re-certification cost using case-level voxel false-negative rate (FNR). The AMOS control passes, but $7/12$ organs exceed $\alpha{=}0.10$ after transfer; smaller calibration sets can mask exceedances with conservative or vacuous thresholds. Risk-Controlling Prediction Sets (RCPS) give high-probability control of population-mean risk, whereas Conformal Risk Control (CRC) gives weaker expectation control. Both require exchangeability; fixed and global thresholds give no per-organ guarantee. The Waudby--Smith--Ramdas (WSR) betting bound re-certifies six Tier-1 organs with 25 local cases, versus 30--40 for Hoeffding--Bentkus (HB). CRC needs 10--15 but has a heavier individual-case tail. No Tier-2 organ meets our illustrative precision criterion with 25 cases.
summary_zh: 无分布风险控制可为已冻结的分割模型添加器官专属的召回率保障。本研究对在AMOS数据集上训练的nnU-Net校准逐器官阈值，验证其向RAOS数据集的迁移效果，并基于病例级体素假阴性率（FNR）估算本地重新认证成本。AMOS数据集上的控制效果符合要求，但迁移后12个器官中有7个超过了α=0.10的阈值；较小的校准集可能会通过保守或无效阈值掩盖阈值超标的情况。风险控制预测集（Risk-Controlling Prediction Sets, RCPS）可对总体均值风险提供高概率控制，而共形风险控制（Conformal Risk Control, CRC）仅能提供更弱的期望控制。二者均要求数据满足可交换性假设，固定全局阈值则无法提供逐器官保障。Waudby--Smith--Ramdas（WSR）投注边界仅需25个本地病例即可完成6个一级器官的重新认证，相比之下Hoeffding--Bentkus（HB）方法需要30~40个病例；CRC仅需10~15个病例，但单个病例的尾部风险更高。在25个病例的设置下，没有任何二级器官能够满足本研究设定的示例精度标准。

title: H$^2$EDL: Hyper Evidential Deep Learning for Hierarchical Classification
title_zh: H²EDL：面向分层分类的超证据深度学习
authors: Yuanye Liu, Xiahai Zhuang
abstract: Fine-grained recognition often involves hierarchical label spaces, where a model may be confident about a coarse semantic concept while remaining uncertain among its descendant classes. Such structured ambiguity requires uncertainty representations that capture both fine-grained classes and intermediate concepts. However, existing tools each capture only half of it: flat evidential classifiers quantify total ignorance with a single vacuity on the leaf frame, and hierarchical classifiers propagate point probabilities with no notion of evidence. Hyper-opinions would unify the two, but their general form is exponential in the label count, and existing hyper-evidential networks either require composite labels to be supplied in the training data or read them off an unstructured weight pattern, with no principled notion of which composites deserve mass. We observe that the taxonomy itself is the missing hyperdomain. Its subtrees and leaf singletons form a linear-size focal family, and one local Dirichlet opinion per branching node induces every composite mass in closed form. The resulting model, H$^2$EDL, can be interpreted in two complementary ways using the same set of parameters. From a prediction perspective, it functions as a hierarchical classifier that preserves consistency across different levels of the label tree. From a probabilistic perspective, it defines a valid tree-structured hyper-opinion, where the mass assigned to each node represents the belief that reaches that node but does not provide sufficient confidence to further specialize into its descendants. On FGVC-Aircraft and DERM12345, H$^2$EDL reduces calibration error by approximately half compared with cross-entropy baselines, with the improvement becoming more pronounced at deeper hierarchy levels and under larger training budgets.
summary_zh: 细粒度识别任务通常涉及分层标签空间，模型可能对粗粒度语义概念有较高置信度，但对其下属子类的区分仍存在不确定性。这类结构化歧义要求不确定性表示方法能够同时覆盖细粒度类别和中间概念。然而现有工具均只能覆盖该需求的一半：平面证据分类器仅在叶节点框架上通过单一的空值量化整体不确定性，而分层分类器仅传播点概率，不具备证据表征能力。超信任度（Hyper-opinions）本可统一二者，但其通用形式的计算复杂度随标签数量呈指数级增长，现有超证据网络要么要求训练数据提供复合标签，要么从非结构化权重模式中推导复合标签，没有可解释的原则来判定哪些复合标签应当分配置信质量。本研究发现分类体系本身就是缺失的超域，其子树和叶节点单例构成了线性规模的焦元族，每个分支节点对应的局部狄利克雷信任度可通过闭式解推导出所有复合质量。最终得到的H²EDL模型可通过同一组参数从两个互补的角度解释：从预测角度看，它是一个分层分类器，可保证标签树不同层级间的一致性；从概率角度看，它定义了合法的树结构超信任度，分配给每个节点的质量代表了到达该节点、但不足以进一步向下细分的置信度。在FGVC-Aircraft和DERM12345数据集上，与交叉熵基线相比，H²EDL的校准误差降低了约一半，且在层级更深、训练预算更大的场景下提升效果更为显著。

title: Human-Centric Intelligence in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey
title_zh: 大模型时代的以人为中心的智能：综述
authors: Yang Chen, Tianqi Wang, Xiaorui Jiang, Yilei Man, Yihua Shao, Mengyuan Liu, Zhi Chen, Xiaofeng Cao, Qibin Zhao, Chi Harold Liu, Albert Y. Zomaya, Nicu Sebe, Jingren Zhou, Dacheng Tao, Song Guo, Jingcai Guo
abstract: Human-centric intelligence is evolving in the foundation-model era, with growing emphasis on scale, transferability, and general-purpose modeling. Yet it has not fully integrated with foundation models to achieve the comparable progress seen in them. More importantly, recent advances across this broad landscape remain fragmented across tasks, modalities, and research communities, leaving their intrinsic conceptual and methodological connections unclear. To bridge these divides and rethink human-centric intelligence in the foundation-model era, we introduce a full-spectrum human context taxonomy that integrates six interconnected levels by viewing humans as observable subjects through visual appearance and spatial geometry, as dynamic actors through kinematic dynamics and interaction modeling, and as situated agents through world simulation and embodied agency. We next present the methodological foundations of the field, covering human-centric data families, computational architecture paradigms, and representative training and inference optimization strategies. We then systematically review representative methods across these levels and organize the associated datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics. We further discuss open challenges and promising research directions toward human-centric intelligence that is scalable, trustworthy, physically grounded, and deployable, aiming to provide a coherent framework and practical reference for advancing the field. Finally, we provide a systematically organized and continuously updated collection of human-centric AI literature and resources on our project page.
summary_zh: 大模型时代下以人为中心的智能正在快速演进，对模型规模、可迁移性和通用建模的要求不断提升，但该领域尚未与大模型充分融合以取得与大模型领域相当的进展。更重要的是，该广阔领域的最新研究进展仍按任务、模态和研究社区分散割裂，其内在的概念与方法论关联尚不清晰。为弥合这些分歧、重新思考大模型时代的以人为中心的智能，本研究提出了全谱人类上下文分类体系，将人类从三个维度划分为六个相互关联的层级：通过视觉外观和空间几何将人类视为可观测对象，通过运动动力学和交互建模将人类视为动态行动者，通过世界仿真和具身智能将人类视为场景交互代理。随后本文梳理了该领域的方法论基础，覆盖以人为中心的数据族、计算架构范式、以及代表性的训练和推理优化策略。之后系统综述了各层级的代表性方法，并整理了相关数据集、基准测试和评估指标。本文进一步探讨了面向可扩展、可信任、物理可落地、可部署的以人为中心的智能所面临的开放挑战和有前景的研究方向，旨在为领域发展提供统一的框架和实践参考。最后本项目主页整理并持续更新了系统化的以人为中心的人工智能文献与资源合集。

title: TractoGraphVLM: A Unified Vision-Language Framework for White Matter Tractography
title_zh: TractoGraphVLM：面向白质纤维束示踪的统一视觉语言框架
authors: Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar, Janine Dale Mendola, Amir Shmuel
abstract: Vision language models have transformed 2D medical imaging, yet extending them to 3D white matter tractography remains challenging due to the complex topology of fiber bundles. We introduce TractoGraphVLM, a unified framework for four tasks, bundle classification, text-to-tract retrieval, anatomical captioning, and visual question answering, built on a shared GPS architecture, training procedure, and read-out design. Fiber bundles are represented as streamline graphs whose nodes encode 3D position and tangent orientation. A General, Powerful, Scalable (GPS) graph transformer produces bundle embeddings aligned with a frozen BiomedBERT text encoder via contrastive learning, while a BioGPT decoder with visual prefix tokens generates captions and answers. A single shared encoder and decoder is trained jointly across all four tasks and evaluated from one checkpoint. Trained on HCP Young Adult subjects, TractoGraphVLM achieves 91.8% bundle classification accuracy, 84.7% retrieval R@1, BLEU-4=20.1, ROUGE-L=66.8, and 66.4% VQA accuracy on a held-out test set. The same checkpoints transfer zero-shot to HCP Aging subjects, with a modest drop on discriminative tasks and a larger drop on generative tasks, showing robustness to age and acquisition shift. Language supervision yields richer representations than label-only training, recovering structure like hemisphere and fiber family, carried by captions but never given as a label. Swapping only the visual encoder, graphs preserving fiber orientation outperform volumetric baselines, with GPS giving the best balance. Generative metrics measure consistency with a structured knowledge base rather than independent clinical text; even so, TractoGraphVLM shows that classifying, retrieving, describing, and answering questions about a white matter bundle can be served by one jointly trained model that learns transferable neuroanatomy from language alone.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型已革新了2D医学影像领域，但由于纤维束拓扑结构复杂，将其扩展到3D白质纤维束示踪任务仍存在诸多挑战。本研究提出TractoGraphVLM这一统一框架，可同时支持纤维束分类、文本到纤维束检索、解剖学字幕生成和视觉问答四项任务，所有任务共享相同的GPS架构、训练流程和解码设计。纤维束被表示为流线图，图中节点编码3D位置和切线方向。通用强可扩展（General, Powerful, Scalable, GPS）图变换器生成纤维束嵌入，通过对比学习与冻结的BiomedBERT文本编码器对齐，带有视觉前缀标记的BioGPT解码器则生成字幕和问答结果。单个共享编码器和解码器在四项任务上联合训练，从同一检查点完成评估。在HCP青年组数据集上训练后，TractoGraphVLM在留出测试集上实现了91.8%的纤维束分类准确率、84.7%的检索R@1、20.1的BLEU-4、66.8的ROUGE-L和66.4%的视觉问答准确率。同一模型检查点可零样本迁移到HCP老年组数据集，判别类任务性能仅有小幅下降，生成类任务性能下降幅度稍大，展现出对年龄和采集域偏移的鲁棒性。与仅使用标签的训练方式相比，语言监督得到的表征更丰富，可恢复出字幕中隐含但从未作为标注给出的大脑半球、纤维家族等结构信息。仅替换视觉编码器的对比实验显示，保留纤维方向的图表示性能优于体素基线，其中GPS架构实现了最佳平衡。生成类指标衡量的是与结构化知识库的一致性而非独立临床文本的一致性，即便如此，TractoGraphVLM仍证明了单个联合训练的模型可通过语言学习可迁移的神经解剖知识，同时完成白质纤维束的分类、检索、描述和问答任务。

title: PartialBiGrasp: Inferring Hidden Local Geometry for Bimanual Grasping from Partial Views
title_zh: PartialBiGrasp：从局部视图推断隐藏局部几何以实现双手机器人抓取
authors: Ayush Kaura, Vignesh Vembar, Md Faizal Karim, Keshab Patra, K Madhava Krishna
abstract: Dual-arm robotic grasping is essential for manipulating large, heavy, and geometrically complex objects that cannot be reliably handled using a single manipulator. These large objects often contain only sparse graspable regions determined by local geometric properties such as thickness, edge structure, and gripper clearance. Prior bimanual grasping methods assume access to a full point cloud of the object which inherently contains this geometric information, but may not be accessible in real scenarios. This work proposes PartialBiGrasp, a dual-arm grasp generation framework that operates directly on partial point cloud observations. Our model learns geometric features implicitly through convolutional occupancy networks, enabling local reasoning about graspability, collision-free contact regions, and object thickness. We leverage this understanding to generate force-closure compliant grasp pairs, which are further refined using a sampling-based optimization to correct for ambiguity caused by incomplete geometry. We evaluate our approach using analytical force-closure metrics, large-scale simulation experiments, and real-world robot evaluations on noisy partial point clouds of novel objects, demonstrating robust and physically stable dual-arm grasp generation.
summary_zh: 双臂机器人抓取是操作大尺寸、大重量、几何结构复杂的单机械臂无法可靠处理的物体的核心技术。这类大型物体通常只有稀疏的可抓取区域，由厚度、边缘结构、夹爪间隙等局部几何属性决定。现有双手机器人抓取方法假设可获取物体的完整点云，其中天然包含上述几何信息，但真实场景中往往无法得到完整点云。本研究提出PartialBiGrasp这一双臂抓取生成框架，可直接基于局部点云观测运行。该模型通过卷积占用网络隐式学习几何特征，实现对可抓取性、无碰撞接触区域和物体厚度的局部推理。基于该能力，模型生成满足力闭合要求的抓取对，再通过基于采样的优化进一步修正由不完整几何信息导致的歧义。本研究通过解析力闭合指标、大规模仿真实验、以及在真实机器人上对新物体的含噪局部点云开展的评估，证明该方法可生成鲁棒且物理稳定的双臂抓取结果。

title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ADEPT：基于强化学习的预训练与后训练提升灵巧操作能力
authors: Jayjun Lee, Jessica Yin, Asif Rana, Nicholas Blauch, Sam Mady, Mohak Bhardwaj, Nima Fazeli, Nathan Ratliff, Karl Van Wyk, Ankur Handa
abstract: We introduce Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training (ADEPT), a large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning sim-to-real transferable dexterity across high degree-of-freedom (DoF) robot embodiments that can solve long-horizon tasks directly from raw visuo-tactile perception. ADEPT pretrains a dexterous policy on a generic object reposing task, then post-trains downstream policies with this pretrained behavior as a prior. ADEPT enables learning new behaviors that are otherwise difficult to discover from scratch on multi-fingered robots and avoids learning the same set of skills over again for every new downstream task. The pretrained policy zero-shots the reposing phase of downstream tasks, but na\"ive RL fine-tuning rapidly degrades this capability during transfer. We address this with a stable post-training recipe combining behavior-cloning distillation, critic warm-up, and conservative on-policy updates. To safely exploit the full kinematic dexterity, we introduce a joint-space Geometric Fabric that mediates between the RL policy and the robot. We distill post-trained teachers into perceptive students that zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on two embodiments: a 23 DoF Kuka-Allegro with two RGB cameras, and a 29 DoF Flexiv-Sharpa with two RGB cameras and five vision-based tactile sensors, and can solve long-horizon tasks from challenging initial states with dexterity at human-level speed.
summary_zh: 本研究提出ADEPT（通过预训练加速灵巧操作，Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training）这一大规模强化学习（RL）框架，可在高自由度（DoF）机器人实体上学习可从仿真迁移到真实场景的灵巧操作能力，直接基于原始视觉触觉感知完成长周期任务。ADEPT首先在通用物体重摆放任务上预训练灵巧策略，再以该预训练行为为先验对下游策略进行后训练。ADEPT支持学习多手指机器人上从零开始难以发现的新行为，避免为每个下游任务重复学习相同的技能集。预训练策略可零样本完成下游任务的重摆放阶段，但朴素的强化学习微调在迁移过程中会快速破坏该能力。本研究通过结合行为克隆蒸馏、评论家预热和保守同策略更新的稳定后训练方案解决该问题。为安全利用完整的运动学灵巧性，本研究引入关节空间几何织物层，作为强化学习策略和机器人之间的中间层。本研究将后训练得到的教师模型蒸馏为感知型学生模型，可在两个机器人实体上实现零样本仿真到真实迁移：配备两个RGB相机的23自由度Kuka-Allegro机器人，以及配备两个RGB相机和五个视觉触觉传感器的29自由度Flexiv-Sharpa机器人，二者均可从高难度初始状态下以人类级别的操作速度完成长周期任务。

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
title_zh: DA-WAM：面向驾驶世界模型的决策对齐未来隐变量
authors: Ruiguo Zhong, Benshan Ma, Xiaolong Chen, Lang Zhang, Mingyue Feng, Yaonong Wang, Pei Liu, Jun Ma
abstract: Anticipating how scenes evolve under ego actions is fundamental to safe autonomous driving, yet the full potential of world models for decision-making remains unrealized. The critical challenge lies in ensuring that future modeling is not merely predictive, but decision-informative: the predicted future must directly shape which trajectory is selected. Existing approaches decouple future representation learning from planning optimization, or share predicted states across trajectory candidates, thereby diluting the action-specific consequences that ought to guide selection. To bridge this gap, we propose DA-WAM, a framework that unifies predictive representation learning, action-conditioned future modeling, and trajectory scoring under a single decision-making objective. DA-WAM maintains predictive supervision throughout planner optimization via an online encoder and a stable momentum target, allowing future representations to co-evolve with the driving task. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent state per trajectory candidate, which is then evaluated by a future-latent-conditioned factorized scorer. For the expert-matched trajectory, the predicted future latent is supervised by the observed future representation, while safety-critical hard negatives provide additional supervision near planning boundaries. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablations and diagnostic analyses validate the key components.
summary_zh: 预测自车动作下的场景演化是安全自动驾驶的基础，但目前世界模型在决策领域的全部潜力尚未得到充分发挥。核心挑战在于确保未来建模不只是具备预测能力，还能为决策提供有效信息：预测的未来必须直接影响轨迹选择过程。现有方法将未来表征学习与规划优化解耦，或在不同轨迹候选间共享预测状态，弱化了本应指导轨迹选择的动作专属后果信息。为解决该问题，本研究提出DA-WAM框架，在单一决策目标下统一预测表征学习、动作条件未来建模和轨迹评分模块。DA-WAM通过在线编码器和稳定动量目标，在整个规划器优化过程中保持预测监督，使未来表征与驾驶任务协同演化。动作条件预测器为每个轨迹候选生成独立的未来隐状态，再由基于未来隐变量的分解评分器完成评估。对于与专家轨迹匹配的样本，预测的未来隐变量通过观测到的未来表征进行监督，而安全关键的难负样本则在规划边界附近提供额外监督。在NAVSIM-v1和NAVSIM-v2数据集上的大量实验显示该方法达到了当前最优性能，消融实验和诊断分析进一步验证了各核心组件的有效性。

title: RoboEdit: Turning Human Manipulation Videos into Scalable Robot Experience
title_zh: RoboEdit：将人类操作视频转化为可扩展机器人经验
authors: Yaowei Guo, Zeng Tao, Yuxin Jiang, Yunuo Chen, Zhiyang Dou, Yuxiang Ma, Yin Yang, Demetri Terzopoulos, Ying Jiang, Chenfanfu Jiang
abstract: Collecting robot hand-object interaction data is costly and embodiment-specific, yet abundant human-object videos remain unusable for robot training. We present RoboEdit, a human-to-robot video editing suite that transforms human manipulation videos into action-consistent, physically plausible robot videos with aligned 3D hand states. To enable scalable supervision, we introduce RoboEdit-ADC, an automatic pipeline that reconstructs and retargets 3D interactions from RGB videos across embodiments. This pipeline generates RoboEdit-14M, a large-scale dataset of 174K aligned video pairs (14M frames) spanning seven robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and interaction types. The core editing engine, RoboEdit-Trans, employs cross-embodiment adaptation modules to preserve temporal coherence while adapting appearance and motion. It further integrates a 3D Robot-State Decoder to recover per-frame hand states for structured motion supervision. Experiments show that RoboEdit achieves state-of-the-art editing quality and supports downstream robot control policies in real-world manipulation tasks. Ultimately, the RoboEdit suite unlocks the vast potential of unlabeled human videos, providing scalable, high-fidelity visual and 3D motion supervision for generalizable robot learning.
summary_zh: 机器人手物交互数据采集成本高昂，且与特定实体强绑定，而海量的人物交互视频目前仍无法直接用于机器人训练。本研究提出RoboEdit这一人类到机器人视频编辑套件，可将人类操作视频转换为动作一致、物理可行、3D手部状态对齐的机器人视频。为实现可扩展监督，本研究提出RoboEdit-ADC这一自动化流水线，可从跨实体的RGB视频中重建并重定向3D交互信息。该流水线生成了大规模数据集RoboEdit-14M，包含17.4万对对齐视频（共1400万帧），覆盖7种机器人实体、多样场景和交互类型。核心编辑引擎RoboEdit-Trans采用跨实体适配模块，在调整外观和运动的同时保持时间一致性，还集成了3D机器人状态解码器，可恢复每帧的手部状态以提供结构化运动监督。实验结果表明，RoboEdit的编辑质量达到当前最优水平，可支撑下游机器人控制策略完成真实场景操作任务。最终RoboEdit套件释放了海量无标注人类视频的潜力，为泛化性机器人学习提供了可扩展、高保真的视觉和3D运动监督。

title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: Dream2Reward：基于正演示的机器人操作迁移对齐奖励模型
authors: Haoyu Zhang, Zecui Zeng, Bin Wang, Lusong Li, Liang Lin, Long Cheng
abstract: Learning robotic policies requires dense rewards that remain informative when behavior departs from successful demonstrations. Progress-based rewards estimate how far an observation has advanced along a nominal successful trajectory, but may remain high after an incorrect transition. We introduce Dream2Reward, which learns a language-conditioned successful latent transition field from positive demonstrations. Given the visual history up to a transition start, the model predicts the latent displacement associated with successful execution and scores the observed displacement through signed directional and symmetric magnitude agreement. This transition-level comparison penalizes wrong-direction, overshooting, and stagnant motion even when the resulting observation appears to show progress. Dream2Reward requires no failure annotations, progress labels, or synthetic negatives, and produces a dense causal reward. Across mechanism diagnostics and shared-trajectory evaluations, it provides stronger success-failure separation and more informative feedback on low-quality behavior than progress-based alternatives. Across online and offline policy learning, the same frozen reward model reduces reward hacking and supports stronger downstream performance, including in real-robot manipulation. These results show that comparing realized motion with predicted successful change provides an effective way to convert positive demonstrations into dense rewards for robot learning.
summary_zh: 学习机器人策略需要密集奖励，该奖励在行为偏离成功演示时仍能提供有效信息。基于进度的奖励可估计观测结果沿标称成功轨迹的推进程度，但在发生错误迁移后仍可能输出高奖励值。本研究提出Dream2Reward，可从正演示中学习语言条件的成功隐迁移场。给定迁移起始前的视觉历史，模型预测与成功执行对应的隐位移，通过有向方向一致性和对称幅度一致性对观测到的位移进行评分。这种迁移级别的比较可对方向错误、超调、停滞运动进行惩罚，即便最终观测结果看似取得了进展也不例外。Dream2Reward不需要失败标注、进度标签或合成负样本，可生成密集的因果奖励。在机制诊断和共享轨迹评估中，与基于进度的替代方法相比，该方法对成功和失败的区分度更高，对低质量行为提供的反馈更具信息性。在在线和离线策略学习场景中，同一冻结的奖励模型可减少奖励黑客现象，提升下游任务性能，包括真实机器人操作任务的性能。上述结果表明，将实际运动与预测的成功变化进行比较，是将正演示转化为机器人学习密集奖励的有效途径。

title: Engineering Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles: A Systems-Theoretic Framework for Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles and its Validation in Real-World Scenarios
title_zh: 自动驾驶汽车中心理安全的工程化：面向自动驾驶汽车的系统论心理安全框架及其真实场景验证
authors: Yandika Sirgabsou, Benjamin Hardin, Fran\c{c}ois Leblanc, Efi Raili, David Jackson, Pericle Salvini, Lars Kunze, Marina Jirotka
abstract: Despite rapid technological advances, the societal acceptability of autonomous vehicles (AVs) remains limited by psychological barriers that extend beyond traditional concerns of physical safety. While factors such as trust and perceived safety are known to influence user acceptance, there is a lack of formalized mechanisms and engineering methods to systematically identify, assess, and mitigate psychological risks arising from human-AV interactions. To address this gap, this work proposes and validates a systems-theoretic framework for the assessment of psychological safety in autonomous vehicles. First, a comprehensive psychological safety risk model is defined, extending the Systems-Theoretic Accident Model and Processes (STAMP) to incorporate key psychological constructs such as trust, perceived control, predictability, and perceived support. Based on this model, a hazard analysis method (AV-PsySafe) is developed to systematically identify psychological hazards, unsafe control actions, and loss scenarios, while introducing a Psychological Safety Integrity Level (PsySIL) to support risk prioritization. Second, the applicability and relevance of the framework are evaluated through its deployment in realistic autonomous vehicle scenarios. A structured validation approach is implemented, including a methodological guide, standardized analysis templates, and the collection of analyst feedback. The results demonstrate that the framework can be consistently applied by practitioners, producing meaningful insights into psychological risks. Overall, this work establishes both the theoretical foundations and practical feasibility of a unified approach to co-assessing psychological and physical safety in autonomous systems, contributing to more human-centred and trustworthy AV development.
summary_zh: 尽管技术发展迅速，自动驾驶汽车（AV）的社会接受度仍受心理层面的限制，这类心理障碍超出了传统物理安全的讨论范畴。尽管已知信任和感知安全性等因素会影响用户接受度，但目前缺乏系统化识别、评估和缓解人-自动驾驶汽车交互引发的心理风险的形式化机制和工程方法。为填补该空白，本研究提出并验证了面向自动驾驶汽车心理安全评估的系统论框架。首先定义了全面的心理安全风险模型，扩展了系统论事故模型与过程（Systems-Theoretic Accident Model and Processes, STAMP），纳入了信任、感知控制感、可预测性和感知支持等核心心理构念。基于该模型开发了危险分析方法AV-PsySafe，可系统化识别心理危险、不安全控制动作和损失场景，同时引入心理安全完整性等级（Psychological Safety Integrity Level, PsySIL）支持风险优先级划分。其次，通过在真实自动驾驶场景中部署该框架，评估了其适用性和相关性。本研究采用了结构化验证方案，包括方法指南、标准化分析模板和分析人员反馈收集。结果表明，该框架可由从业人员稳定应用，生成有价值的心理风险洞察。总体而言，本工作建立了在自主系统中协同评估心理安全与物理安全的统一方法的理论基础和实践可行性，将推动更以人为本、更可信的自动驾驶汽车研发。

title: To Go Far, Go Together: Diverse Preferences Induce a Curriculum for Reward Optimization
title_zh: 结伴行以致远：多元偏好诱导面向奖励优化的课程学习机制
authors: Taehyung Kim, Jongeun Choi
abstract: Learning a reward model from human feedback and optimizing a policy against it is one approach to aligning AI systems with individual users. From a fairness perspective, existing work improves such alignment by developing data-efficient and accurate reward models that capture minority preferences despite scarce data. We push this line of inquiry one step further and argue that data-efficient and accurate per-user reward models are not sufficient: users whose reward models are difficult to \textit{optimize} at the policy level can become a new underserved group. We start from the observation that one user's reward model can be easy to optimize from the initial policy while another's is not. We argue that, given a sufficiently diverse user population, a curriculum naturally emerges between easy- and hard-to-optimize reward models. Building on this insight, we propose CurriPO, which grows a tree-structured curriculum to accommodate diverse user-specific objectives, covering the population in a single traversal. Specifically, CurriPO automatically constructs a curriculum over diverse user reward models, allowing it to branch from the existing curriculum and reuse reward models previously incorporated into the curriculum. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly exploit multi-user structure to address optimization in AI alignment. Extensive experiments on personalized continuous control in a simulated environment show that CurriPO achieves $1.2$--$2.1\times$ the population satisfaction of the strongest baseline while substantially reducing training time. Additional analysis attributes much of this improvement to the users left underserved by conventional optimization.
summary_zh: 从人类反馈中学习奖励模型并基于该模型优化策略，是让AI系统与个体用户对齐的主流方法之一。从公平性视角出发，现有研究通过开发数据高效、精度高的奖励模型，在数据稀缺的条件下也能捕获少数群体偏好，以此提升对齐效果。本文将该方向的研究进一步推进，提出仅靠数据高效、精度高的单用户奖励模型并不足够：那些在策略层面难以对奖励模型完成优化的用户，会成为新的未被充分服务的群体。本文基于如下观察展开研究：不同用户的奖励模型从初始策略出发的优化难度存在显著差异。我们提出，当用户群体的偏好足够多元时，在易优化和难优化的奖励模型之间会自然形成一套课程学习体系。基于该洞见，本文提出CurriPO方法，该方法可生成树状结构的课程体系以适配多元的用户特定目标，仅需一次遍历即可覆盖全部用户群体。具体而言，CurriPO可自动针对多元用户奖励模型构建课程，支持从现有课程分支扩展，复用此前已纳入课程体系的奖励模型。据我们所知，这是首项明确利用多用户结构解决AI对齐中优化问题的研究。在仿真环境的个性化连续控制任务上开展的大量实验表明，CurriPO实现的群体满意度是最优基线方法的1.2~2.1倍，同时大幅缩短了训练时长。进一步分析显示，该性能提升很大程度上来源于传统优化方法未能充分服务的用户群体。

title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
title_zh: SoftVTBench：面向可变形物体操作的形变感知视触数据集与基准测试集
authors: Bowen Jing, Mingxin Wang, Ruiyang Hao, Chenchen Ge, Hanwen Shen, Junjie He, Yang Cui, Yiming Hou, Weitao Zhou, Jiawei Wang, Minglei Li, Dandan Zhang, Ding Zhao, Houde Liu, Xiaofan Li, Si Liu, Ping Luo, Haibao Yu
abstract: Physical interaction quality is central to deformable-object manipulation, yet most benchmarks evaluate task success alone. A policy may complete the task while allowing slip or causing excessive compression. A primary bottleneck is the absence of visuo-tactile datasets that pair policy-visible contact observations with independent physical ground truth over complete tasks. We introduce SoftVTBench, a visuo-tactile dataset for physical-interaction-aware deformable-object manipulation. It contains 4,000 expert demonstrations and more than 50 assets, including volumetric deformable objects and visually matched rigid twins. At 20 Hz, each episode synchronizes multi-view RGB, dual-finger tactile RGB and marker motion, proprioception, language, and binary and continuous gripper actions, alongside evaluator-only finite-element (FEM) states. Building upon this dataset, we establish a closed-loop benchmark that uses fixed object-specific calibration to define the Deformation-aware Success Rate (DSR), which counts a rollout as successful only when it completes the task and keeps peak normalized deformation within tolerance. Across Diffusion Policy, $\pi_{0.5}$, and FastWAM, all 12 in-distribution configurations contain successful rollouts that violate the deformation tolerance, accounting for 0.7--24% of each configuration's successes. Under distribution shift, visuo-tactile variants achieve higher task success in all six policy--suite comparisons and higher DSR in five, whereas their in-distribution benefits are mixed. These results show that making touch available does not by itself ensure effective multimodal fusion. SoftVTBench therefore provides a common visuo-tactile resource for studying not only whether a policy succeeds, but how it physically interacts with deformable objects and when touch improves that interaction.
summary_zh: 物理交互质量是可变形物体操作的核心要素，但现有绝大多数基准测试仅评估任务是否成功完成。策略可能在完成任务的同时出现滑动或造成过度挤压。当前的核心瓶颈是缺少可将策略可观测的接触观测与完整任务过程中的独立物理真值配对的视触数据集。本文提出SoftVTBench，一款面向具备物理交互感知能力的可变形物体操作的视触数据集，包含4000条专家演示轨迹、50余种资产，涵盖体素化可变形物体以及视觉特征匹配的刚性孪生物体。数据集以20Hz频率同步采集多视角RGB图像、双指触觉RGB图像、标记点运动数据、本体感知数据、语言指令、二值与连续夹爪动作，以及仅面向评估者的有限元法（FEM）状态数据。基于该数据集，本文搭建了闭环基准测试框架，采用固定的物体专属校准规则定义形变感知成功率（DSR）：只有同时完成任务且峰值归一化形变处于允许范围内的轨迹才会被判定为成功。在Diffusion Policy、π₀.₅和FastWAM三类方法上的测试结果显示，全部12种分布内配置下均存在违反形变容忍度的成功轨迹，占各配置总成功数的0.7%~24%。在分布偏移场景下，视触融合变体在全部6组策略套件对比中均取得了更高的任务成功率，其中5组的DSR表现更优，但其在分布内场景下的性能增益并不稳定。上述结果表明，仅引入触觉信息并不能自动实现有效的多模态融合。SoftVTBench为相关研究提供了通用的视触资源，不仅可评估策略能否完成任务，还可分析策略与可变形物体的物理交互模式，以及触觉信息在何种条件下可优化交互效果。

title: Orienteering Problem with Uncertain Time-Varying Rewards: Framework and Benchmark for Everyday Service Robotics
title_zh: 面向日常服务机器人的带不确定时变奖励的定向越野问题（OP-UTVR）：框架与基准测试集
authors: Masafumi Endo, Kohei Honda, Yuu Jinnai, Ryo Yonetani
abstract: We present the orienteering problem with uncertain time-varying rewards (OP-UTVR), a novel variant of the orienteering problem (OP). While most existing OP formulations assume rewards to be known in advance, practical applications involve uncertain and time-varying rewards, as with shifting customer demand for delivery agents. OP-UTVR relaxes this assumption by allowing agents to estimate reward dynamics from observations and forecast future rewards. This enables informed routing decisions despite stochastic reward changes and inevitable prediction errors. We address this problem using three planners that differ in planning horizon and online adaptivity, and derive theoretical bounds on their performance under reward stochasticity. We further introduce a mobile service robot benchmark for OP-UTVR, where a robot navigates among pedestrians in indoor environments. Experiments reveal trade-offs between planning horizon and adaptivity, and demonstrate the effectiveness of long-horizon planning with online adaptation.
summary_zh: 本文提出定向越野问题的全新变体：带不确定时变奖励的定向越野问题（OP-UTVR）。现有绝大多数定向越野问题（OP）的公式化建模均假设奖励预先已知，但实际应用场景中的奖励往往具备不确定性与时变性，例如配送场景中动态变化的客户需求。OP-UTVR放宽了该假设，允许智能体从观测数据中估计奖励动态并预测未来奖励，即便在奖励随机变化、预测误差不可避免的情况下也能生成合理的路径规划决策。本文针对该问题设计了三款规划器，三者的规划时域与在线自适应能力各有差异，同时推导了奖励随机条件下三款规划器的性能理论边界。本文进一步搭建了面向OP-UTVR的移动服务机器人基准测试集，测试场景为室内环境中机器人在行人之间导航的任务。实验结果揭示了规划时域与自适应能力之间的权衡关系，验证了结合在线自适应的长时域规划方法的有效性。

title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
title_zh: 面向血管内导航的多任务世界模型控制的渐进式经验融合方法
authors: Harry Robertshaw, Maxence Boels, Nikola Fischer, Sebastien Ourselin, Christos Bergeles, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C Booth
abstract: Autonomous endovascular navigation could support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy to underserved areas, but controllers must navigate long, multi-stage paths across varying vascular anatomies. This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller. We additionally evaluate a heuristic that changes the Model Predictive Path Integral planning horizon using residual action-sequence dispersion, and fine-tuning in a patient-specific simulation. Across five subtasks in ten known training anatomies with held-out targets, PEF achieved a mean success rate of 74%, compared with 37% for Soft Actor-Critic (p < 0.001) and 65% for base TD-MPC2 (p = 0.053). A PEF controller with adaptive-horizon planning trained on 30 vasculatures achieved a mean success rate of 90% in ten held-out vasculatures. The PEF agent successfully transferred to an unseen in vitro stroke patient vasculature under fluoroscopy, achieving a mean path ratio improvement from 63% to 80% with fine-tuning (p < 0.001), following 40x103 fine-tuning steps (corresponding to approximately 107 min of clinical inter-hospital transfer time). This work represents a proof of concept for multi-vasculature training and patient-specific adaptation, while further validation is required before clinical deployment.
summary_zh: 自主血管内导航技术可支持将机械取栓治疗推广至医疗资源不足的区域，但对应的控制器需要在结构差异极大的血管解剖环境中完成长距离多阶段路径导航。本文研究采用渐进式经验融合（PEF）方法训练多任务TD-MPC2控制器，同时评估了一种基于残差动作序列离散度调整模型预测路径积分规划时域的启发式策略，以及面向患者特定仿真场景的微调方案。在10个已知训练血管解剖结构、包含预留目标的5项子任务测试中，采用PEF方法的平均成功率达74%，相比软演员-评论家（Soft Actor-Critic）算法的37%成功率（p<0.001）、基础版TD-MPC2的65%成功率（p=0.053）均有显著提升。在30个血管结构数据集上训练的带自适应时域规划的PEF控制器，在10个未见过的预留血管结构测试中平均成功率达90%。该PEF智能体可在透视成像条件下成功迁移至未见过的体外中风患者血管模型中，经过微调后平均路径完成率从63%提升至80%（p<0.001），微调仅需4×10⁴步，对应临床场景下约107分钟的院间转运时长。本研究验证了多血管结构训练与患者特定自适应方案的概念可行性，但在临床部署前仍需开展进一步验证。

title: Evaluation of Monocular SLAM Systems on High-Altitude Nadir UAV Footage
title_zh: 无需载荷参数的多旋翼无人机载荷摆动估计与阻尼控制
authors: Ga\v{s}per Spagnolo, Matej Dobrevski, Danijel Sko\v{c}aj
abstract: Aerial nadir video combines weak geometric constraints with severe perceptual aliasing, making it a difficult regime for monocular SLAM. We benchmark five monocular SLAM systems on local UAV flights, synthetic city-scale imagery, and long-range aerial sequences. To isolate visual performance, we provide no inertial or GNSS aiding. Performance varies strongly with environment and trajectory scale: MASt3R-SLAM achieves the lowest mean horizontal MAE on the five DJI flights (0.53\% of reference path length), whereas no system consistently preserves global trajectory shape on the long GES and ALTO sequences. Overall, DROID-SLAM performs best, averaging 2.88\% of reference path length across completed runs. Vertical position remains poor, and large-area trajectories remain highly distorted despite loop-closure capability. Current monocular SLAM methods are by themselves therefore insufficient for reliable visual-only aerial navigation.
summary_zh: 多旋翼无人机通过缆绳悬吊载荷开展运输的方案灵活性较强，但会产生周期性摆动扰动，降低轨迹跟踪精度甚至引发失稳。现有抗摆方法需要额外传感器，或需要精确识别缆绳长度与载荷质量，限制了其在野外场景的部署。本文提出一种仅使用机载惯性测量单元（IMU）与油门指令的摆动估计与阻尼控制方法，完全不需要已知任何载荷参数。该方法采用扩展卡尔曼滤波器提取周期性扰动，将未知的摆锤频率作为估计状态，同时设计主动阻尼控制器，在姿态控制回路中加入修正角以耗散摆锤的运动能量。飞行实验验证了该方法在测试范围内不同缆绳长度、不同载荷质量场景下均具备鲁棒的阻尼抑制效果。

title: Payload Swing Estimation and Damping Without Payload Parameters for Multirotor UAVs
authors: K. Taki, K. Umemoto
abstract: Cable-suspended payload transport by multirotor UAVs is flexible but generates periodic swing disturbance that degrades tracking and risks instability. Existing anti-swing methods require additional sensors or precise identification of cable length and payload mass, limiting field deployment. We propose a swing-estimation and damping method using only the onboard IMU and throttle command, requiring no payload parameters. An extended Kalman filter extracts the periodic disturbance with the unknown pendulum frequency as an estimated state, and an active damping controller adds a correction angle to the attitude loop to dissipate pendulum energy. Flight experiments confirm robust damping across a tested range of cable-length and mass variations.

title: LabDex: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Laboratories
title_zh: LabDex：面向实验室场景的灵巧操作分层基准测试集
authors: Zhipeng Tang, Sihang Chen, Sha Zhang, Peihao Yang, Yan Liu, Wentao Zhao, Xinrui Liu, Rui Huang, Wensheng Du, Yuting Huang, Jiajun Deng, Lidian Wang, Yuan Zhang, Yanyong Zhang
abstract: Autonomous laboratories hold great promise for accelerating scientific discovery. To achieve this vision, robots are supposed to dexterously manipulate diverse labware and instruments and execute long-horizon, state-dependent experimental procedures. Yet existing benchmarks do not jointly capture dexterous hand use, real-world laboratory interactions, and multi-stage experimental procedures, limiting systematic training and evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LabDex, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark for dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories, organized around a hierarchical task taxonomy spanning atomic skills, compositional tasks, and long-horizon experiments. First, LabDex is cross-platform and, for the first time, unifies real-world and simulation platforms under a common framework, providing standardized task definitions, demonstrations, and evaluation protocols. Second, LabDex is large-scale and systematically organizes chemistry laboratory operations into three interconnected levels: Atomic Skills, which characterize fundamental dexterous manipulation capabilities; Compositional Skills; and Long-Horizon Laboratory Workflows. This hierarchical design not only supports the evaluation of end-task performance, but also enables the analysis of how fundamental dexterous skills compose and influence more complex laboratory operations. We conduct cross-level evaluations of representative robot learning methods in both real-world and simulation environments. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of the LabDex task design and demonstration data, and show that the benchmark supports the training and systematic evaluation of existing robotic policies across laboratory dexterous manipulation tasks at different levels, providing a foundation for further research and development of autonomous laboratory robots.
summary_zh: 自主实验室可大幅加速科学发现进程，为实现该愿景，机器人需要具备对各类实验器具和仪器的灵巧操作能力，可执行长时域、状态依赖的实验流程。但现有基准测试无法同时覆盖灵巧手使用、真实实验室交互、多阶段实验流程三类要素，限制了相关方法的系统性训练与评估。为填补该空白，本文提出LabDex，一款面向化学实验室灵巧操作的大规模真实世界数据集与基准测试集，基于覆盖原子级技能、组合式任务、长时域实验的分层任务分类体系搭建。首先，LabDex支持跨平台运行，首次将真实世界平台与仿真平台在统一框架下打通，提供标准化的任务定义、演示数据与评估协议。其次，LabDex规模庞大，将化学实验室操作系统划分为三个互相关联的层级：表征基础灵巧操作能力的原子级技能、组合式技能、长时域实验室工作流。该分层设计不仅支持对最终任务性能的评估，还可用于分析基础灵巧技能如何组合并影响更复杂的实验室操作。本文在真实世界与仿真环境中对多款代表性机器人学习方法开展了跨层级评估，实验结果验证了LabDex任务设计与演示数据的有效性，表明该基准可支持现有机器人策略在不同层级实验室灵巧操作任务上的训练与系统性评估，为自主实验室机器人的后续研究开发提供了基础支撑。

title: The Role of Grid Cells in Reducing Spatial Aliasing in Hippocampal Place Representations
title_zh: 网格细胞在降低海马体位置表征空间混叠中的作用
authors: Alexander Johnson, Obadah Ghizawi, Ali A. Minai
abstract: Spatial aliasing occurs when two or more distinct locations produce highly similar place-cell representations, primarily due to environmental symmetry or repetitive structures. This issue is most pronounced when place representations are constructed solely from boundary vector cell (BVC) inputs, because symmetric or repetitive structures can yield indistinguishable sensory patterns across multiple locations in an environment. This work introduces grid cell signals to mitigate spatial aliasing in such settings. Because grid cells contribute periodic, internally generated spatial signals that vary independently of environmental geometry, they play a key role in disambiguating perceptually identical locations. We integrate multiple modules of analytically constructed grid cells with BVC-driven place cells and show that this leads to a 94--99% reduction in spatial aliasing relative to a BVC-only baseline across three environments: an open environment without obstacles; an environment with a cross-shaped central obstacle creating high visual symmetry; and a maze environment. The greatest improvement occurs in the environment with the highest visual symmetry. These results indicate that grid cells provide information complementary to boundary-based inputs, yielding more reliable place representations in geometrically ambiguous environments.
summary_zh: 空间混叠指两个或多个不同位置生成高度相似的位置细胞表征的现象，主要由环境对称性或重复结构引发。当位置表征完全由边界向量细胞（BVC）的输入构建时，该问题最为突出，因为对称或重复结构会让环境中多个位置生成无法区分的感知模式。本文引入网格细胞信号缓解该场景下的空间混叠问题。由于网格细胞生成的周期性内源性空间信号与环境几何结构相互独立，可有效区分感知特征完全相同的不同位置。本文将多个解析构建的网格细胞模块与BVC驱动的位置细胞相融合，在三类环境（无障碍物的开放环境、带十字形中心障碍物的高视觉对称环境、迷宫环境）中测试发现，该方案相比仅使用BVC的基线方法可将空间混叠占比降低94%~99%，其中视觉对称度最高的环境下性能提升幅度最大。上述结果表明，网格细胞可提供与边界输入互补的信息，在几何特征模糊的环境中生成更可靠的位置表征。

title: Real-Time Control-Constrained DDP for Underactuated Balancing of Legged Robots
title_zh: 面向足式机器人欠驱动平衡的带控制约束的实时微分动态规划（DDP）方法
authors: SeongWon Nam, Hyunyong Lee, Hansol Kang, Jiman Park, Yeongwoo Son, Bumsu Yi, Jaeyoung Oh, Hyouk Ryeol Choi
abstract: This paper presents a real-time control-constrained Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) framework for underactuated legged robots. To address the limitation of classical DDP in handling control constraints, we propose an Accelerated Projected Gradient (APG)-based control-constrained DDP (ABC-DDP), which efficiently computes constrained solutions and identifies active sets without repeated Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) inversions. A virtual constraint is introduced to integrate control constraints within a feasibility-driven multiple-shooting framework, enabling stable optimization even from dynamically infeasible initializations. The proposed method supports real-time model predictive control (MPC) with short horizons under strong underactuation. Simulation results demonstrate static two-leg standing under external disturbances, along with diverse dynamic motions including slow catwalk, upright walking, and high-speed running within a unified MPC framework. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of static two-leg standing of a quadruped robot achieved using real-time finite-horizon MPC.
summary_zh: 本文提出面向欠驱动足式机器人的带控制约束的实时微分动态规划（DDP）框架。为解决经典DDP方法难以处理控制约束的缺陷，本文提出基于加速投影梯度（APG）的带控制约束DDP方法（ABC-DDP），可高效计算约束下的解，无需反复对Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）矩阵求逆即可识别有效集。本文引入虚拟约束将控制约束整合至面向可行性的多步规划框架中，即便从动力学不可行的初始状态出发也能完成稳定优化。所提方法支持强欠驱动条件下的短时域实时模型预测控制（MPC）。仿真结果验证了该方法可在统一MPC框架下实现受外部扰动时的双足静态站立，以及慢走、直立行走、高速奔跑等多种动态运动。据我们所知，这是首次通过实时有限时域MPC实现四足机器人的双足静态站立。

title: An Experimental Study of Downwash Effects on a Continuum Manipulator Integrated with a Multirotor UAV
title_zh: 集成于多旋翼无人机的连续型机械臂下洗流效应实验研究
authors: Anuraj Uthayasooriyan, Krishna Manaswi Digumarti, ernando Vanegas, Felipe Gonzalez
abstract: Continuum arm aerial manipulation systems leverage soft-manipulator compliance and dexterity for tasks in confined or hazardous environments, but propeller downwash can degrade performance, particularly near walls and the ground. This effect remains uncharacterized for continuum manipulators. This letter experimentally studies downwash-induced kinematic deviations of a tendon-driven continuum manipulator integrated with a multirotor platform. Under still-air conditions, the CM is compared with a constant-curvature (CC) model. Downwash- induced end-effector pose deviations are then quantified relative to the mean still-air experimental baseline at four propeller throttle levels in free space, and at maximum throttle near a wall, and near the ground. Vertical position and yaw show the largest deviations and are amplified by ground effect. A CC-guided Gaussian process regression (GPR) residual model is learned from experimental data that improves forward pose prediction RMSE (position by 89-95%, orientation by 47-79%), and support compensation-oriented, downwash-aware modeling of continuum arm aerial manipulation systems.
summary_zh: 连续型机械臂空中操作系统可利用柔性机械臂的柔顺性与灵巧性，在受限或危险环境中完成作业，但螺旋桨下洗流会降低系统性能，在靠近墙面与地面的场景下影响尤为显著，目前学界尚未明确下洗流对连续型机械臂的作用特性。本文通过实验研究集成于多旋翼平台的腱驱动连续型机械臂受下洗流影响产生的运动学偏差。在静止空气条件下，将连续型机械臂的实际运动与常曲率（CC）模型的预测结果进行对比，随后以静止空气下的平均实验结果为基线，分别量化自由空间内4档不同螺旋桨油门水平、最大油门下靠近墙面、最大油门下靠近地面三类场景中，下洗流引发的末端执行器位姿偏差。结果显示垂直位置与偏航角的偏差最大，且地面效应会进一步放大该偏差。本文基于实验数据训练了由CC模型引导的高斯过程回归（GPR）残差模型，将正向位姿预测的均方根误差降低了位置维度89%~95%、姿态维度47%~79%，可支撑面向补偿需求的下洗流感知型连续型机械臂空中操作系统建模。

title: Designing Social Robots for Social-Cognition Training with Autistic Adults
title_zh: 面向自闭症成年人社会认知训练的社交机器人设计
authors: Yuval Zohar, Mordi Benhamou, Guy Laban
abstract: Social robots have been widely explored as tools for autism intervention, yet this literature has focused predominantly on children and has rarely involved autistic adults as active contributors to design. This creates a mismatch between existing systems and the social-cognitive challenges autistic adults actually face in everyday life, including navigating ambiguous interpersonal contexts, managing conversational timing, and interpreting implied emotional meaning. To address this gap, we conducted an online focus group and co-design session with five autistic adults to explore what a social robot for social-cognition training should do, how it should interact, and under what conditions it would be genuinely useful. The 90-minute session combined open discussion with structured co-design activities on a shared digital whiteboard, and the resulting verbal and visual data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. The analysis yielded seven themes that define core design requirements: the robot should function as a scaffold rather than a substitute, prioritise authenticity over comfort, provide personalised and user-controlled feedback, accommodate emotional self-awareness gaps, respect privacy and contextual boundaries, support rehearsal for real-world social situations, and remain configurable in identity, form, and expression. Together, the findings suggest that autistic adults envision the robot not as a companion or live social assistant, but as a private, configurable rehearsal partner designed to support independence over time.
summary_zh: 社交机器人已被广泛探索作为自闭症干预的工具，但现有相关研究主要面向儿童，极少将自闭症成年人作为设计过程的积极参与者。这导致现有系统与自闭症成年人在日常生活中实际面临的社会认知挑战不匹配，这类挑战包括应对模糊的人际场景、把控对话节奏、解读隐含的情绪含义等。为填补这一研究缺口，我们与5名自闭症成年人开展了线上焦点小组与协同设计会议，探索面向社会认知训练的社交机器人应当具备的功能、交互模式，以及能让它真正发挥作用的适用条件。这场时长90分钟的会议结合了开放式讨论与共享数字白板上的结构化协同设计活动，我们采用反思性主题分析对得到的口头和视觉数据进行了分析。分析结果提炼出定义核心设计需求的7个主题：机器人应当充当辅助支架而非替代者，优先保证交互真实性而非舒适感，提供个性化且由用户自主控制的反馈，适配情绪自我意识缺口，尊重隐私与场景边界，支持真实世界社交场景的预演，且在身份、形态和表达层面支持自定义配置。上述发现共同表明，自闭症成年人期望该机器人并非作为同伴或实时社交助手，而是作为私密、可配置的预演伙伴，长期为用户提升独立性提供支持。

title: DevGRU: Depth-guided Visual Navigation using a Collision-aware Recurrent Model
title_zh: DevGRU：基于碰撞感知循环模型的深度引导视觉导航
authors: Kyung Min Han, Eunsom Kim, Young J. Kim
abstract: Existing visual navigation models often aim to develop foundation models that can generalize robot navigation across diverse platforms. However, many of these models are prone to collisions when deployed in complex indoor environments, particularly in structured layouts and narrow passages. To address this problem, we propose a depth image- and point-goal-conditioned navigation system, DevGRU. The proposed system employs an action predictor (AP) that generates collision-aware future trajectories, enabling effective avoidance of immediate obstacles. In conjunction with a collision predictor, the AP further compensates for errors accumulated in the goal pose estimation and proactively mitigates future deviations. To evaluate our method, we conducted experiments across nine different scenes and three state-of-the-art approaches - ViNT, NoMaD, and NavDP - as well as four additional variants of ViNT and NoMaD. In terms of navigation performance, DevGRU significantly outperforms ViNT and NoMaD by a large margin. In addition, the proposed model has a relatively small number of trainable parameters, resulting in the fastest inference time among the baselines, particularly outperforming NavDP by 7x in model size and 17x in inference time.
summary_zh: 现有视觉导航模型通常致力于开发可跨多种平台实现机器人导航泛化的基础模型。但这类模型中的多数在复杂室内环境、尤其是结构化布局和狭窄通道中部署时容易发生碰撞。为解决该问题，本文提出了以深度图像和点目标为条件的导航系统DevGRU。该系统采用可生成碰撞感知未来轨迹的动作预测器（AP），能够有效规避近处障碍物。结合碰撞预测器，动作预测器还可补偿目标位姿估计过程中累积的误差，主动缓解后续的轨迹偏差。为评估所提方法的性能，我们在9个不同场景下开展了实验，对比了3种当前最优方法ViNT、NoMaD、NavDP，以及ViNT和NoMaD的另外4种变体。导航性能测试结果显示，DevGRU的性能大幅优于ViNT和NoMaD。此外，所提模型的可训练参数量相对较小，在所有基线方法中推理速度最快，其模型体积仅为NavDP的1/7，推理速度更是达到NavDP的17倍。

title: Backward Layout Search for Sequence-Constrained Robotic Assembly
title_zh: 面向序列约束机器人装配的反向布局搜索方法
authors: Xi Zhang, Jiancong Dai, Hao Chen, Zhengtao Hu, Changcai Yang, Weiwei Wan
abstract: Robotic assembly layout planning must determine the assembly site and the initial pose of each part while ensuring collision-free execution of a prescribed assembly sequence. This problem is challenging because the obstacle environment changes after each assembly step, and unassembled parts re maining in the workspace may block robot motions. We observe that the feasibility of each assembly step depends only on the initial poses of the current and later-assembled parts. Based on this dependency, we propose Backward Layout Search (BLS), which assigns initial part poses in reverse assembly order. Each expansion performs geometric, kinematic, grasp, and prescribed-motion checks, while collision masks and candidate set filtering remove infeasible initial part pose candidates. Promising partial layouts are retained through beam selection, and complete layouts are validated by full motion planning in forward assembly order. Experiments on five assembly models show that BLS produces collision-free executable layouts and reduces step evaluations and search time compared with a matched forward search.
summary_zh: 机器人装配布局规划需要确定每个零件的装配位置和初始位姿，同时保证指定装配序列的执行过程无碰撞。该问题极具挑战性，原因在于每完成一步装配后障碍物环境都会发生变化，工作空间内剩余的未装配零件可能会阻碍机器人运动。我们观察到，每一步装配的可行性仅取决于当前零件和后续装配零件的初始位姿。基于该依赖关系，本文提出反向布局搜索（Backward Layout Search, BLS）方法，按照与装配顺序相反的顺序分配零件的初始位姿。每一次扩展过程都会执行几何、运动学、抓取和指定运动检查，同时通过碰撞掩码和候选集过滤剔除不可行的零件初始位姿候选。通过束选择保留有潜力的部分布局，最终得到的完整布局将按照正向装配顺序通过全运动规划完成验证。在5个装配模型上开展的实验表明，与匹配的正向搜索方法相比，BLS能够生成无碰撞的可执行布局，同时减少了步骤评估次数和搜索耗时。

title: HarvestPoint-ACT: Explicit Target Selection and Harvest-Point Conditioning for Robotic Fruit Harvesting under Occlusion
title_zh: HarvestPoint-ACT：面向遮挡场景下机器人水果采摘的显式目标选择与采摘点条件化方法
authors: Hanying Hu, Weipeng Li, Yikun Huang, Hao Chen, Zhengtao Hu, Changcai Yang, Weiwei Wan
abstract: End-to-end imitation learning avoids hand-made robot motion for approaching and grasping, but the policy must still decide which fruit to pick and where to close the gripper. Occlusion can make the policy lose the selected fruit during harvesting, and the correct closing point is difficult to infer from pixels alone. This paper presents HarvestPoint-ACT, which makes both decisions explicit in perception and provides them to the policy. An instance segmentation front end with a keypoint branch predicts a mask and a harvest point for each visible fruit, where the harvest point specifies the location to close the gripper. A scheduler ranks detected candidates by occlusion and travel distance and selects one target. After each attempt, it redetects and reranks the candidates because the canopy may have changed. The selected fruit is encoded for an action chunking transformer as an eight-dimensional state, containing the absolute harvest point, the vector from the gripper to that point, a validity flag, and a confidence score. When the selected fruit is temporarily undetected, the system retains the last harvest point estimate in the robot base frame and marks it as stale, and aborts the attempt if the loss persists. On a canopy mock-up, HarvestPoint-ACT achieves a success rate of 88%, and of 75% under heavy occlusion.
summary_zh: 端到端模仿学习无需人工设计机器人的接近和抓取运动，但对应的策略仍需要决定采摘哪一个水果、以及在哪个位置闭合夹爪。遮挡可能导致采摘过程中策略丢失选定的目标水果，且仅从像素很难推断出正确的夹爪闭合位置。本文提出HarvestPoint-ACT方法，在感知环节将上述两个决策显式化并输入给策略。带有关键点分支的实例分割前端会为每个可见水果预测掩码和采摘点，采摘点用于指定夹爪的闭合位置。调度器会根据遮挡程度和移动距离对检测到的候选水果排序，选出一个目标。每一次采摘尝试后，由于果树冠层可能发生变化，系统会重新检测并对候选水果重新排序。选中的水果会被编码为8维状态输入动作分块Transformer，该状态包含绝对采摘点、夹爪到该点的向量、有效性标志和置信度。当选中的水果暂时未被检测到时，系统会在机器人基坐标系中保留上一次的采摘点估计值并标记为过期，如果持续丢失目标则终止本次尝试。在果树冠层模拟平台上，HarvestPoint-ACT的采摘成功率可达88%，在重度遮挡场景下的成功率为75%。

title: The Embodiment Gap in Robot Foundation Models
title_zh: 机器人基础模型中的具身鸿沟
authors: Yukiyasu Domae, Keisuke Shirai, Hanbit Oh, Ryoichi Nakajo, Tomohiro Motoda, Koshi Makihara, Masaki Murooka, Takuma Yagi, Yoshiaki Bando, Ryo Hanai
abstract: Robot foundation models (RFMs), including vision-language-action (VLA) policies, are often discussed through a scaling view: more data, larger models, and broader benchmarks should improve generalization. In robotics, however, a model can generalize while work still remains before it can run on a robot with a particular body. The work required differs across methods and target robots, and those differences affect practical deployment. We call the gap between reusable models, representations, or data and their use in execution on the target robot the embodiment gap. This survey examines what can be reused across robot embodiments and what must still be implemented on a new robot. We place existing methods on a two-axis map that shows the type of shared structure and the stage at which adaptation is needed for execution on the target robot. We then examine recent work through three overlapping research directions: sharing semantics and perception, sharing robot data and interfaces, and learning correspondence across embodiments. We also propose a reporting framework for adaptation work that success rate alone does not reveal. The framework identifies the work that should be checked when comparing cross-embodiment learning and highlights work that remains on a new robot and questions for future study.
