title: More Context, Same Budget: Dual-Bounded Relational Recall Beyond Top-K Retrieval
title_zh: 相同预算下拓展上下文：超越Top-K检索的双边界关系召回方法
authors: Thomson D. Nguy
abstract: The result is straightforward: under the same context budget, complete-evidence retrieval depends not only on which items rank highest, but on how context is allocated around them. Relational allocation recovered complete evidence sets that flat top-k retrieval left incomplete.
summary_zh: 研究结论十分明确：在相同的上下文预算约束下，完整证据检索不仅取决于排名最高的条目，还取决于上下文在这些条目周边的分配方式。关系分配机制能够恢复普通扁平化Top-K检索无法覆盖的完整证据集合。

title: Tangut Word Segmentation under Extreme Resource Scarcity: Integrating Traditional Lexicons and Unlabeled Text
title_zh: 极端资源稀缺场景下的西夏文分词：融合传统词典与无标注文本
authors: Lifan Deng, Yongwei Zhang, Sen Sun, Bojun Sun, Jingsong Yu
abstract: Tangut is an extinct language whose script does not explicitly mark word boundaries. We present the first systematic study of Tangut word segmentation using 2,750 expert-annotated segments(31,893 tokens), traditional lexicons, and unlabeled text. Our framework combines a reliability-calibrated lexicon-lattice representation, explicit distributional statistics, and a lightweight character encoder pretrained with MLM. Segment-level five-fold cross-validation shows that lexical and statistical features raise CRF F1 to approximately 0.91. The full TangutEncoder reaches the highest mean F1 (0.911) and improves recall beyond the labeled training vocabulary. These results demonstrate generalization beyond the limited supervised vocabulary across thematically diverse held-out passages, while document-level transfer remains to be evaluated.
summary_zh: 西夏文是一种已灭绝的语言，其文字系统没有显式标记词边界。本文基于2750条专家标注分词样本（共31893个令牌）、传统词典与无标注文本，首次开展西夏文分词的系统性研究。该框架融合经过可靠性校准的词典格表示、显式分布统计特征，以及经过掩码语言建模（MLM）预训练的轻量级字符编码器。分词级五折交叉验证结果显示，词汇与统计特征可将条件随机场（CRF）的F1值提升至约0.91，完整模型TangutEncoder取得最高的平均F1值（0.911），且在标注训练词表之外的召回率表现更优。上述结果证明，该模型在主题多样的留存语料上具备超出有限监督词表的泛化能力，文档级迁移效果仍有待后续评估。

title: Figurative and Cultural Knowledge in LLMs: Investigating Cross-Domain Transfer through Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 大语言模型中的修辞与文化知识：基于微调的跨域迁移研究
authors: Mena Attia, Mona Diab, Thamar Solorio
abstract: Figurative language is deeply culturally embedded; fluent use requires not just linguistic competence but cultural immersion. We ask whether LLMs can learn this link: does fine-tuning on cultural data improve figurative language understanding, and vice versa? We conduct a systematic study across four models (ALLaM-7B, Fanar-1-9B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and six Arabic datasets spanning cultural commonsense, proverbs, and poetry across diverse dialects and regions. Fine-tuning on poetry improves idiom comprehension (+2.33%, p<0.05), a gain our ArabicMMLU control does not reproduce, indicating that it stems from figurative content rather than Arabic language adaptation and pointing to a sensitivity to non-literal meaning that transfers across figurative types. Cultural fine-tuning, by contrast, lowers proverb-interpretation accuracy in both Arabic-centric models. Transfer between the two domains is otherwise indistinguishable from noise, with Arabic models frequently regressing after fine-tuning, suggesting prior saturation of relevant knowledge, while multilingual models show greater adaptation headroom. Error analysis further reveals that fine-tuning reinforces experiential cultural knowledge while destabilizing historically grounded factual knowledge. Our findings suggest that the relationship between culture and figurative language, though conceptually natural, is not straightforwardly captured through fine-tuning alone.
summary_zh: 修辞语言深度嵌入文化语境，流畅使用修辞不仅需要语言能力，还需要文化浸润。本文探究大语言模型能否学习到二者的关联：在文化数据上微调能否提升修辞语言理解能力，反之亦然？本文在4个模型（ALLaM-7B、Fanar-1-9B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B）与6个阿拉伯语数据集上开展系统性研究，数据集覆盖不同方言、不同地区的文化常识、谚语与诗歌内容。在诗歌数据上微调可将习语理解准确率提升2.33%（p<0.05），该提升效果无法通过阿拉伯语MMLU对照实验复现，说明提升来源于修辞内容而非阿拉伯语语言适配，证明模型对非字面语义的感知能力可在不同修辞类型间迁移。与之相对，面向文化知识的微调反而会降低阿拉伯语原生模型的谚语解释准确率。两个领域之间的其余跨域迁移效果与随机噪声无显著差异，阿拉伯语模型微调后性能经常出现倒退，说明其相关知识已达到饱和，而多语言模型仍有较大的适配空间。错误分析进一步显示，微调会强化经验性文化知识，但会破坏基于历史事实的知识稳定性。研究结果表明，文化与修辞语言的关联虽然在概念层面十分自然，但无法仅通过微调直接被大语言模型捕获。

title: Artifact-centered Claim-aware Observability for Autonomous Scientific Agents
title_zh: 面向自主科学智能体的以科研产物为中心、感知声明的可观测性方案
authors: Xiangyu Yin, Ming Du, Michael H. Prince, Mathew J. Cherukara
abstract: Autonomous scientific agents now increasingly propose ideas, write code, run experiments, analyze results, and even draft papers. Observe and audit those agents are necessary but logging every model call is not enough, scientists also need to inspect the artifacts and claims that the systems produced and their relations. This is driven by the fact that failures in scientific agent systems are often distributed across several objects. A manuscript claim may cite the wrong evidence, a search process may select a degenerate candidate, a laboratory novelty claim may depend on an unstated rule, or a multi-agent plan may change without a visible trigger. Existing tracing, experiment tracking, and archival provenance tools are valuable, but their native objects do not make these scientific audit relations first-class. We argue that autonomous scientific systems should emit portable, claim-aware artifact lineage as a minimum audit layer. We propose a compact observability profile organized around individuals, operators, fitness records, lineage, archives, runs, streams, and steering commands. In this profile, scientific claims are ordinary individuals with explicit evidence bindings and verification records. The profile is intended as a semantic layer that complements current telemetry and provenance standards. Execution details can remain in OpenTelemetry. Final packages can export to PROV-O or RO-Crate standards.
summary_zh: 当前自主科学智能体已可自主提出研究思路、编写代码、运行实验、分析结果甚至撰写论文。对这类智能体进行观测与审计十分必要，但仅记录每一次模型调用是远远不够的：科研人员还需要核查系统生成的各类科研产物、研究声明及其相互关联。这一需求的核心动因是科学智能体系统的故障通常分散在多个不同对象中：稿件中的声明可能引用了错误证据、搜索过程可能筛选出了退化候选、实验室的创新性声明可能依赖于未公开的规则、多智能体规划可能在无可见触发条件的情况下发生变更。现有的链路追踪、实验跟踪与档案溯源工具具备实用价值，但它们的原生对象体系并未将这类科研审计关系作为一等公民对待。本文提出自主科学系统应当输出可移植、感知声明的科研产物谱系作为最低审计层；同时设计了一套围绕个体对象、算子、适配性记录、谱系、归档文件、运行实例、数据流与调控指令构建的精简可观测性框架。在该框架中，科研声明属于普通个体对象，附带明确的证据绑定关系与验证记录。该框架可作为语义层对现有遥测与溯源标准形成补充：执行细节可继续存储在OpenTelemetry（开放遥测标准）中，最终产出包可导出为PROV-O（溯源本体标准）或RO-Crate（研究成果打包标准）格式。

title: Efficient INT8 Inference of Small NLP Models on Server CPUs with PyTorch Native Stack
title_zh: 基于PyTorch原生技术栈在服务器CPU上实现小型NLP模型的高效INT8推理
authors: Weiwen Xia, Yuxin Cui, E Cao
abstract: Small NLP models, especially BERT-family encoders, remain important in industrial workloads such as classification, ranking, and retrieval even in the era of large language models. On server CPUs, INT8 quantization offers an attractive latency-throughput-cost trade-off, but users increasingly expect such acceleration to be available directly in the native PyTorch stack. We integrate SmoothQuant into TorchAO and optimize the resulting inference path for Intel Xeon CPUs through graph-level fusion in TorchInductor and efficient INT8 GEMM kernel selection across oneDNN-, AVX512_VNNI-, and AMX-based implementations. Across BERT, DistilBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa benchmarks, the approach delivers up to 5.8x end-to-end throughput speedup with negligible---and in some cases no measurable---accuracy loss relative to the FP32 baseline. We also validated our work by detailed performance analysis with roofline models. The implementation has been upstreamed to PyTorch and TorchAO, enabling out-of-the-box deployment with native PyTorch tooling
summary_zh: 即便是在大语言模型时代，以BERT系列编码器为代表的小型NLP模型在分类、排序、检索等工业工作负载中仍占据重要地位。在服务器CPU平台上，INT8量化可在延迟、吞吐量与成本之间实现极具吸引力的平衡，但用户越来越期望这类加速能力可以直接在原生PyTorch技术栈中获得。本文将SmoothQuant（平滑量化技术）集成到TorchAO中，通过TorchInductor中的图级融合、以及基于oneDNN、AVX512_VNNI、AMX实现的高效INT8 GEMM内核选型，对生成的推理路径针对英特尔至强CPU进行了全链路优化。在BERT、DistilBERT、XLM-RoBERTa基准测试集上，该方案相比FP32基线可实现最高5.8倍的端到端吞吐量提升，精度损失可忽略不计，部分场景下甚至完全没有可测量的精度下降。本文还通过屋顶线模型完成了详细的性能分析，验证了方案的有效性。目前该实现已合并入PyTorch与TorchAO上游仓库，用户可直接使用原生PyTorch工具链开箱部署。

title: MicroPython and CircuitPython: Pythons Quiet Takeover of IoT and Robotics
title_zh: MicroPython与CircuitPython：Python对物联网与机器人领域的悄然渗透
authors: Sayed Mahbub Hasan Amiri, Atiar Zahan
abstract: Background: Python has become the dominant language in software and data science, yet embedded systems have remained tied to C/C++ due to performance and memory constraints. MicroPython and CircuitPython are changing this by bringing Python to microcontrollers, lowering barriers for IoT and robotics development. Aim: This article examines whether these platforms are achieving a quiet takeover of embedded systems, focusing on ecosystem growth, practical applications, performance trade-offs, educational adoption, and prospects. Methods: A mixed-methods design was used, including quantitative analysis of GitHub, Stack Overflow, and Google Trends data; curation of case studies from Hackster.io, Hackaday.io, and the Adafruit Learning System; and original benchmarks on ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico comparing MicroPython, CircuitPython, and Arduino C++ across GPIO, I2C, SPI, Wi-Fi, and memory usage. Results: Metrics show sustained growth, with MicroPython supporting over 200 boards and CircuitPython over 400. Benchmarks reveal 10-20 times slower I/O and four to six times higher memory use than C, but performance remains adequate for common sensor and network tasks. Case studies demonstrate successful deployment in home automation, robotics, wearables, agriculture, and professional prototyping. Education emerges as a primary adoption driver. Conclusions: Python is not replacing C/C++; rather, it is becoming the default prototyping and educational language for embedded systems. Continued hardware improvements, better tooling, and standardization will likely deepen this trend. The article offers balanced, evidence-based insights for developers, educators, and technology decision-makers.
summary_zh: 研究背景：Python已经成为软件与数据科学领域的主流语言，但受性能与内存限制，嵌入式系统长期以来仍以C/C++为主要开发语言。MicroPython与CircuitPython将Python引入微控制器领域，大幅降低了物联网与机器人开发的门槛，正在改变这一现状。研究目标：本文从生态增长、实际应用、性能权衡、教育普及、发展前景多个维度，考察上述平台是否正在嵌入式领域实现悄然渗透。研究方法：采用混合研究方法，包括对GitHub、Stack Overflow、谷歌趋势数据的定量分析，从Hackster.io、Hackaday.io、Adafruit学习系统中筛选整理案例研究，以及在ESP32与树莓派Pico硬件上开展的原生基准测试，从GPIO、I2C、SPI、Wi-Fi与内存占用维度对比MicroPython、CircuitPython与Arduino C++的表现。研究结果：各项指标均显示两类Python生态持续增长，目前MicroPython已支持200余款开发板，CircuitPython支持400余款开发板。基准测试结果显示，二者的I/O性能比C语言慢10-20倍，内存占用高出4-6倍，但该性能水平完全可以满足常见传感器与网络任务的需求。案例研究证明二者已在智能家居、机器人、可穿戴设备、农业、专业原型开发场景中成功落地，教育是推动其普及的核心动力。研究结论：Python并未取代C/C++，而是正在成为嵌入式系统默认的原型开发与教学语言。后续硬件性能提升、工具链优化与标准化工作将进一步深化这一趋势。本文为开发者、教育工作者与技术决策者提供了基于实证的均衡参考观点。

title: Alignment Is All You Need: Instruction-Free Training for General Audio-Language Models
title_zh: 你只需对齐：面向通用音频语言模型的无指令训练方法
authors: Xuanru Zhou, Yiwen Shao, Jiahong Li, Dong Yu
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are typically built through a multi-stage pipeline consisting of cross-modal alignment, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and preference optimization. This pipeline assumes that adapting an LLM to a new modality requires extensive task-specific supervision. However, pretrained LLMs already possess strong reasoning and instruction-following abilities. As LLMs evolve rapidly, an important question remains: can we efficiently transfer these capabilities to a new modality with minimal intervention, and is alignment alone sufficient for building a multimodal model? We introduce an Instruction-Free Alignment-Only large audio-language model (LALM) that keeps both the audio encoder and the LLM fully frozen, learning only a lightweight projector. Borrowing insights from AzeroS [1], we train on (audio, response) pairs from Self-Generated Data Construction, where an LLM expands captions into free-form responses without explicit task instructions. Across MMAU, MMAR, MMSU, and MMAU-Pro, our approach matches or surpasses heavily post-trained baselines using substantially less data. By keeping the LLM frozen, our model preserves its native instruction-following competence and can port seamlessly across model generations. Our results suggest that competitive MLLM can emerge from alignment alone, reducing multimodal extension to a lightweight projector-training problem that generalizes across modalities and adapts rapidly to each new LLM release.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通常采用跨模态对齐、监督微调（SFT）、偏好优化的多阶段流水线构建，该流水线假设将大语言模型适配到新模态需要大量面向特定任务的监督数据。但预训练大语言模型本身已经具备极强的推理与指令遵循能力，随着大语言模型技术快速迭代，一个关键问题浮出水面：我们能否以极低的干预成本将这些能力迁移到新模态，仅靠对齐环节是否就足以构建多模态模型？本文提出仅对齐的无指令大音频语言模型（LALM），该方案完全冻结音频编码器与大语言模型的全部参数，仅训练一个轻量级投影层。借鉴AzeroS[1]的研究思路，本文使用自生成数据构建得到的（音频，响应）配对数据完成训练：由大语言模型将音频描述扩展为自由格式响应，全程无需显式任务指令。在MMAU、MMAR、MMSU、MMAU-Pro多个测试集上，本文提出的方案使用远少于其他方法的训练数据，表现即可匹配甚至超越经过大量后训练的基线模型。由于全程冻结大语言模型参数，该模型可以完整保留大语言模型原生的指令遵循能力，可无缝适配不同代际的大语言模型。研究结果表明，仅通过对齐环节即可构建具备竞争力的多模态大语言模型，将多模态扩展简化为轻量级投影层训练问题，该方案可跨模态泛化，也能快速适配每一代新发布的大语言模型。

title: Operationalizing Narrative Entropy (Sn): A Two-Scene Registered Pilot Report and Pre-Validation Protocol
title_zh: 叙事熵（Sn）的落地实现：双场景注册先导报告与预验证方案
authors: Levent Bulut
abstract: Narrative Entropy ($S_n$) is a proposed quantitative descriptor within the Bulut Doctrine, intended to capture the rate at which a narrative text imposes processing load on a reader. To date the construct has been defined theoretically but not operationalized against real texts. This report documents the first such operationalization (the v2.0 pilot): two narrative scenes -- the opening restaurant scene of Tarantino's Reservoir Dogs and the opening interior-monologue block of Carver's Cathedral -- were coded manually by a single rater and scored with the candidate formula $S_n = I_f \times C_b \times t$. The result was a divergence from the author's naive intuition: the single-voice monologue ($S_n = 30.0$) scored higher than the nine-character dialogue scene ($S_n = 18.8$). We treat this not as a result to be explained away but as the central finding, and we refuse post-hoc adjustment of the formula. Three competing interpretations are presented -- formula incompleteness, genuine high-load prose, and measurement error -- and the design that would discriminate among them is pre-registered. This v2.1 revision adds: (i) explicit acknowledgement that the divergence is consistent with the pre-existing architectural framework which privileges inferential reconstruction over surface declaration, and that what was called "contrary to expectation" in v2.0 reflected the author's anticipatory intuition rather than the methodology's own predictions; (ii) a pre-registered construct validity test for $I_f$, motivated by the observation that $I_f$ values were nearly equal across the two scenes (1.71 vs 1.58) despite the headline $S_n$ divergence. The document functions simultaneously as a pilot report ($n=2$) and as a pre-registration of the next-stage protocol. It does not claim that $S_n$ has been validated.
summary_zh: 叙事熵（$S_n$）是Bulut Doctrine中提出的定量描述指标，用于表征叙事文本给读者带来的处理负载速率。目前该指标仅完成了理论层面的定义，尚未在真实文本中落地实现。本报告记录了首个落地实现方案（v2.0先导版）：选取两个叙事场景——Tarantino执导的电影《落水狗》开篇餐厅场景、Carver所著小说《大教堂》开篇内心独白段落，由单一标注员完成人工编码，使用候选公式$S_n = I_f \times C_b \times t$完成打分。最终结果与作者的朴素直觉存在偏差：单人独白段落的得分（$S_n=30.0$）高于9人对话场景的得分（$S_n=18.8$）。本文并未将该偏差作为需要解释的异常结果，而是将其作为核心研究发现，拒绝事后调整公式。本文提出了三种可能的解释：公式不完备、该独白本身确实属于高负载文本、测量误差，同时预注册了可区分三种解释的实验设计。本次v2.1版本新增内容包括：（1）明确承认该偏差与现有架构框架完全一致，该框架优先考虑推理重构而非表层表述，v2.0中所谓的“与预期相反”实际反映的是作者的预判直觉，而非方法论本身的预测结果；（2）针对$I_f$的预注册构念效度测试，提出动因是尽管两个场景的$S_n$得分差异显著，但二者的$I_f$值几乎持平（1.71 vs 1.58）。本文同时作为样本量为2的先导报告与下一阶段研究方案的预注册文件，并未声称$S_n$指标已经通过验证。

title: FrenchNews-7: Benchmarking Cross-Publisher French News Editorial Desk Classification
title_zh: FrenchNews-7：跨出版商的法语新闻编辑台分类基准
authors: Amr Sobhy
abstract: We present FrenchNews-7, a cross-publisher France-based French-language news editorial desk classification benchmark combining a large multi-outlet corpus, a URL-derived seven-class taxonomy, and a fine-tuned CamemBERT classifier. Labels are assigned via a hybrid pipeline combining publisher URL slugs with LLM annotation for structurally ambiguous cases, audited through an inter-rater study (2 humans + 2 LLMs; pairwise $\kappa \geq 0.766$, human--human $\kappa = 0.806$). We evaluate lexical, multilingual, and French-specific trained classifiers under both in-distribution and held-out-publisher settings, with additional comparison against zero-shot LLM baselines (GPT-OSS-120B, Mistral Small 3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) on the held-out pool. The strongest model, CamemBERT-base on full article text, outperforms headline-only input, generalizes to unseen outlets, and exceeds all three zero-shot LLM baselines on overall recall (0.799), with the gap concentrated in the ambiguous editorial-boundary categories Economie and Societe. Cross-publisher evaluation reveals uneven boundary stability: Sport, Culture & Loisirs, and International transfer cleanly, while Economie (recall = 0.517) is close to blinded human agreement (0.55), and Societe (precision = 0.577) absorbs boundary ambiguity, both suggesting editorial conventions rather than recoverable classifier headroom. The fine-tuned CamemBERT-base model, labeled manifest, reference collection scripts, and a reliability-tier guidance table are available at https://huggingface.co/LeFrenchNewsLab/camembert-base-frenchnews7 (model) and https://huggingface.co/datasets/LeFrenchNewsLab/frenchnews-7 (dataset).
summary_zh: 本文提出FrenchNews-7跨出版商法语新闻编辑台分类基准，该基准整合了多来源大规模语料库、基于URL生成的7类分类体系、以及经过微调的CamemBERT分类器。标签标注采用混合流水线：结合出版商URL路径标识与大语言模型标注处理结构歧义案例，标注结果经过标注者间一致性研究校验（2名人类标注员+2个大语言模型，两两配对的科恩kappa系数≥0.766，人类之间的kappa系数为0.806）。本文在分布内场景与预留出版商场景下对词汇级分类器、多语言分类器、法语专属训练分类器进行了评估，同时在预留数据集上与零样本大语言模型基线（GPT-OSS-120B、Mistral Small 3.2、Llama-3.3-70B）进行了对比。表现最优的模型是基于全文本训练的CamemBERT-base，其表现优于仅使用标题输入的模型，可泛化到未见过的新闻媒体，整体召回率达0.799，超过全部三个零样本大语言模型基线，性能差距主要集中在Economie（经济）与Societe（社会）这类编辑边界模糊的类别上。跨出版商评估结果显示不同类别的边界稳定性差异较大：Sport（体育）、Culture & Loisirs（文化休闲）、International（国际新闻）三个类别的跨出版商迁移效果极佳，而Economie类的召回率仅为0.517，接近盲测人类标注的一致性水平0.55，Societe类的精确率为0.577，吸收了大量边界歧义，二者的表现说明性能瓶颈来自不同出版商的编辑惯例差异，而非分类器的能力上限。经过微调的CamemBERT-base模型、标注说明文档、参考数据集构建脚本、可靠性层级指南表已开源发布，模型地址为https://huggingface.co/LeFrenchNewsLab/camembert-base-frenchnews7，数据集地址为https://huggingface.co/datasets/LeFrenchNewsLab/frenchnews-7。

title: Persona-Guided LLM Agents for Task-Oriented Dialogue
title_zh: 面向任务型对话的人格引导大语言模型智能体
authors: Maryam Shoaeinaeini, Brent Harrison, A. B. Siddique
abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can express diverse personality traits in open-ended text generation. However, it remains unclear whether they can do so in a goal-directed dialogue without compromising task completion, and whether adapting to the user's personality improves the interaction quality. We study these questions in task-oriented dialogue (TOD), where a system helps a user accomplish a goal via multi-turn interaction. We build a training-free framework that simulates a TOD interaction between two LLMs: a user agent that exhibits a target personality and a system agent that adapts to the user while completing the task. To isolate the effect of adaptation, we vary how much the system knows about the user's personality across three conditions. In Neutral, the system receives no personality information. In Try, it infers the personality from dialogue cues. In Oracle, it is given the personality explicitly. We evaluate GPT-4o, Qwen3-Next-80B, and Gemini 2.0 Flash on Hotel and Restaurant dialogues from the Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) dataset, across the Big Five traits and their opposite poles. We find that the user agent can express personality while the system maintains strong task performance, although some traits are realized far less reliably than others. Adapting to the user's personality improves constraint satisfaction, inform rate, and user satisfaction, but lowers truthfulness, revealing a trade-off between personalization and task-grounding. Oracle's gains grow when the target trait is strongly expressed, whereas Try's gains are largely insensitive to realization strength. Overall, cue-based adaptation in Try best resolves this trade-off and offers a more reliable route to personality-aware TOD without fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 现有研究已经证明大语言模型（LLM）可以在开放式文本生成中展现多样的人格特质，但目前仍不清楚大语言模型能否在不损害任务完成效果的前提下，在目标导向对话中保持对应人格，也不清楚适配用户人格能否提升交互质量。本文针对任务型对话（TOD）场景开展研究，该场景下系统需要通过多轮交互帮助用户完成特定目标。本文构建了无需训练的框架，模拟两个大语言模型之间的任务型对话交互：一个用户智能体展现目标人格特质，另一个系统智能体在完成任务的同时适配用户人格。为了隔离人格适配的影响，本文设置了三种对照条件，控制系统可获取的用户人格信息量：Neutral条件下系统完全不掌握人格信息，Try条件下系统从对话线索中推断用户人格，Oracle条件下系统直接获得明确的用户人格设定。本文在Schema-Guided Dialogue（SGD，模式引导对话）数据集中的酒店、餐厅对话子集上，针对大五人格特质及其对立维度，对GPT-4o、Qwen3-Next-80B、Gemini 2.0 Flash三个模型开展评估。研究发现：用户智能体可以稳定展现人格特质，系统智能体也可以同时保持优秀的任务完成性能，不过部分人格特质的实现可靠性远低于其他特质。适配用户人格可以提升约束满足率、信息完整度与用户满意度，但会降低内容真实性，揭示了个性化与任务保真之间的权衡关系。当目标人格特质表现强烈时，Oracle条件带来的性能增益会进一步提升，而Try条件的性能增益几乎不受人格表现强度的影响。总体来看，基于对话线索的Try条件可以最好地平衡上述权衡，无需微调即可实现更可靠的人格感知任务型对话。

title: Compiler-Guided Adaptive Proof Search with Cross-Model Synergy on Context-Dependent Theorem Proving
title_zh: 上下文相关定理证明中结合跨模型协同的编译器引导自适应证明搜索
authors: Zhuo Liu, Ding Yu, Hangfeng He
abstract: Theorem proving in real-world Lean 4 projects is challenging because proofs often depend on project-specific context. While iterative refinement can use compiler errors to repair failed proofs, reusing failed attempts requires careful search control: some proofs provide better starting points than others, and later revisions may degrade a partially correct proof. We propose a compiler-guided proof search framework that balances exploration and exploitation. It explores diverse starting points through dual-model generation and stagnation-triggered resampling, while exploiting promising proof states through current-best refinement guided by compiler-grounded pairwise comparison. Experiments on seven real-world Lean 4 projects from miniCTX-v2 show that our method achieves a better effectiveness--efficiency tradeoff than pass@k baselines. Within the pass@32 budget, our method improves average pass rate by 12.8 percentage points while reducing LLM calls by 21.9%.
summary_zh: 在真实世界的Lean 4项目中开展定理证明极具挑战性，因为证明过程通常依赖于项目专属的上下文信息。虽然迭代优化方法可以利用编译器错误修复失败的证明，但复用失败的尝试需要精细的搜索控制：不同的证明尝试作为起点的质量差异很大，后续的迭代修改甚至可能破坏原本部分正确的证明。本文提出编译器引导的证明搜索框架，在探索与利用之间实现平衡：该框架通过双模型生成与停滞触发重采样机制探索多样化的证明起点，同时通过基于编译器反馈的成对比较筛选当前最优证明状态，对高潜力的证明状态进行深度优化。在miniCTX-v2数据集中的7个真实Lean 4项目上开展的实验表明，本文提出的方法相比pass@k基线实现了更优的有效性-效率权衡：在pass@32的计算预算下，平均通过率提升12.8个百分点，大语言模型调用次数减少21.9%。

title: Entity tracking emerges in sub-billion parameter language models and exceeds human performance in naturalistic narratives
title_zh: 十亿参数以下语言模型已涌现实体跟踪能力，在自然叙事任务中表现超越人类
authors: Karolina Dro\.zd\.z, Micha Heilbron
abstract: Understanding language requires tracking entities across discourse - i.e., knowing where things are and how they change, even when not explicitly stated. Whether language models perform such tracking in a human-like fashion remains unclear, in part because existing evaluations rely on artificial tasks, far removed from natural language comprehension, and lack comparisons to humans. Here, we evaluate entity tracking in both language models and humans (N = 48) using naturalistic narratives at multiple levels of complexity. In humans, we find that entity tracking degrades specifically with narrative complexity, not narrative length. In language models, we find that human-level entity tracking is already present at 410 million parameters - well below the multi-billion parameter, code-specialised models identified by prior work - and improves with scale, with contemporary models far exceeding human performance. Together, these results demonstrate that entity tracking, a core component of language understanding, emerges at model scales far smaller than previously thought.
summary_zh: 理解语言需要在整个语篇跨度内跟踪实体：即便是实体没有被明确提及，也需要掌握实体的位置与状态变化。目前语言模型是否能以类人方式完成这类实体跟踪仍不明确，部分原因是现有评估依赖于和自然语言理解差异极大的人工设计任务，也缺乏与人类表现的直接对比。本文使用不同复杂度的自然叙事文本，同时对语言模型与48名人类受试者开展实体跟踪能力评估。针对人类受试者的实验结果显示，实体跟踪能力仅会随叙事复杂度提升而下降，与叙事长度无关。针对语言模型的实验结果显示，参数规模仅为4.1亿的语言模型就已经达到人类水平的实体跟踪能力，远低于此前研究认为的需要数十亿参数的代码专用模型阈值，且实体跟踪能力随模型规模扩大持续提升，当前主流大模型的实体跟踪表现已经远超人类。上述结果共同证明，作为语言理解核心组件的实体跟踪能力，在远小于此前预期的模型参数规模下就已经可以涌现。

title: LongNovel: A Multi-Scale Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Long-Context Novel Summarization
title_zh: LongNovel：面向长上下文小说摘要的多尺度幻觉检测基准
authors: Ruizhi Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Xiangju Lu, He Yan, Mo Yu, Junmin Zhu, Wei Zhang
abstract: Although context windows have expanded significantly in recent years, hallucinations in long-context summarization remain a challenge. Long novels are better suited than news or papers for researching these hallucinations, due to their intrinsic information and detailed descriptions of events and dialogues. However, current research lacks a multi-scale benchmark for hallucination detection in long-context novel summarization and does not fully explore how hallucinations change as the context grows longer. In this study, we propose LongNovel, a multi-scale long-context bilingual (Chinese and English) novel benchmark for hallucination detection. This benchmark is constructed from 29 Chinese novels (ranging from 16k to 100k tokens) and chapter-level data from the BookSum dataset. We design 8 hallucination types and employ a combination of Multi-Model Arbitration and Entity-Referenced Hallucination Generation to ensure both data authenticity and a balanced distribution of hallucination categories. Furthermore, we manually revise the content in the test set to guarantee data reliability. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LongNovel is a challenging benchmark. We release LongNovel for future research. https://github.com/BDML-lab/LongNovel
summary_zh: 近年来大语言模型的上下文窗口规模大幅提升，但长上下文摘要中的幻觉问题仍未得到有效解决。相比新闻或学术论文，长篇小说的信息密度更高，事件与对话的细节描述更丰富，更适合用于幻觉问题研究。但目前相关研究领域缺乏面向长上下文小说摘要的多尺度幻觉检测基准，也没有充分探索幻觉随上下文长度增长的变化规律。本文提出LongNovel多尺度长上下文双语（中英）小说幻觉检测基准，该基准由29部中文小说（token长度从16k到100k不等）与BookSum数据集的章节级数据构建而成。本文设计了8类幻觉，结合多模型仲裁与实体关联幻觉生成方法，同时保证了数据真实性与幻觉类别的分布均衡，还对测试集内容进行了人工修订，确保数据可靠性。大量实验结果证明LongNovel是一个极具挑战性的基准，本文已将LongNovel数据集开源供后续研究使用，项目地址为https://github.com/BDML-lab/LongNovel。
